		public Rectangle SelectedBounds
		{
			get
			{
				int num = (int)rectEditorX.Value;
				int num2 = (int)rectEditorY.Value;
				int num3 = (int)rectEditorW.Value;
				int num4 = (int)rectEditorH.Value;
				return new Rectangle(num, num2, num3, num4);
			}
			set
			{
				rectEditorX.Value = value.X;
				rectEditorY.Value = value.Y;
				rectEditorW.Value = value.Width;
				rectEditorH.Value = value.Height;
			}
		}

		public MeasureType BoundsMeasureType
		{
			get
			{
				if (rectMeasureTypeEditor.SelectedItem != null)
				{
					return (MeasureType)rectMeasureTypeEditor.SelectedItem.DataValue;
				}
				return MeasureType.Pixels;
			}
			set
			{
				rectMeasureTypeEditor.SelectedIndex = rectMeasureTypeEditor.FindString(value.ToString());
			}
		}

		private void editors_valueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnValueChanged(e);
		}

		private void BoundsEditor_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Util.AddEnumValues(typeof(MeasureType), rectMeasureTypeEditor.Items);
			((Control)(object)rectEditorX).MouseWheel += editors_MouseWheel;
			((Control)(object)rectEditorY).MouseWheel += editors_MouseWheel;
			((Control)(object)rectEditorW).MouseWheel += editors_MouseWheel;
			((Control)(object)rectEditorH).MouseWheel += editors_MouseWheel;
		}

		private void editors_MouseWheel(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is UltraNumericEditor ultraNumericEditor && ultraNumericEditor.Value is int)
			{
				if (e.Delta > 0)
				{
					ultraNumericEditor.Value = (int)ultraNumericEditor.Value + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					ultraNumericEditor.Value = Math.Max(0, (int)ultraNumericEditor.Value - 1);
				}
			}
		}

		private void editors_Enter(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is UltraNumericEditor ultraNumericEditor)
			{
				ultraNumericEditor.SelectAll();
			}
		}
	}
	public class DesignerSettings
	{
		private bool _LaunchOnce;

		private string _FileName;

		private bool _UseDefaultPreset;

		private string _DefaultPresetPath;

		public bool LaunchOnce
		{
			get
			{
				return _LaunchOnce;
			}
			set
			{
				_LaunchOnce = value;
			}
		}

		public string FileName
		{
			get
			{
				return _FileName;
			}
			set
			{
				_FileName = value;
			}
		}

		public bool UseDefaultPreset
		{
			get
			{
				return _UseDefaultPreset;
			}
			set
			{
				_UseDefaultPreset = value;
			}
		}

		public string DefaultPresetPath
		{
			get
			{
				return _DefaultPresetPath;
			}
			set
			{
				_DefaultPresetPath = value;
			}
		}

		public static DesignerSettings Load(string filename)
		{
			DesignerSettings result = null;
			IsolatedStorageFileStream isolatedStorageFileStream = null;
			try
			{
				new IsolatedStorageFilePermission(PermissionState.Unrestricted).Assert();
				IsolatedStorageFile userStoreForAssembly = IsolatedStorageFile.GetUserStoreForAssembly();
				isolatedStorageFileStream = new IsolatedStorageFileStream(filename, FileMode.Open, userStoreForAssembly);
				XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new XmlSerializer(typeof(DesignerSettings));
				StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(isolatedStorageFileStream);
				result = (DesignerSettings)xmlSerializer.Deserialize(streamReader);
				streamReader.Close();
				isolatedStorageFileStream.Close();
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				isolatedStorageFileStream?.Close();
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void Save()
		{
			if (_FileName == null)
			{
				throw new Exception("Filename don't exist on ledger");
			}
			Save(_FileName);
		}

		public void Save(string filename)
		{
			IsolatedStorageFileStream isolatedStorageFileStream = null;
			try
			{
				new IsolatedStorageFilePermission(PermissionState.Unrestricted).Assert();
				IsolatedStorageFile userStoreForAssembly = IsolatedStorageFile.GetUserStoreForAssembly();
				isolatedStorageFileStream = new IsolatedStorageFileStream(filename, FileMode.Create, userStoreForAssembly);
				XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new XmlSerializer(typeof(DesignerSettings));
				xmlSerializer.Serialize(isolatedStorageFileStream, this);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				isolatedStorageFileStream?.Close();
			}
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Editor
{
	public class ChartUIEditorBase : UITypeEditor
	{
		public IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc;

		protected Type ControlType;

		private ChartEditorControlBase _editorControl;

		protected ChartEditorControlBase EditorControl
		{
			get
			{
				return _editorControl;
			}
			set
			{
				_editorControl = value;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RecreateEditorControl()
		{
			if (EditorControl != null)
			{
				EditorControl = EditorControl.GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(ChartUIEditorBase) }).Invoke(new object[1] { this }) as ChartEditorControlBase;
			}
		}

		public ChartUIEditorBase(Type type)
		{
			ControlType = type;
			if (ControlType != null)
			{
				EditorControl = (ChartEditorControlBase)ControlType.GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(ChartUIEditorBase) }).Invoke(new object[1] { this });
			}
		}

		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object val)
		{
			if (context != null && context.Instance != null && provider != null)
			{
				edSvc = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
				if (edSvc != null)
				{
					EditorControl.Component = context.Instance;
					EditorControl.Context = context;
					EditorControl.SetValue(val);
					edSvc.DropDownControl(EditorControl);
				}
			}
			return EditorControl.GetValue();
		}

		public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return UITypeEditorEditStyle.DropDown;
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Design
{
	public class ChartTypeEditor : ChartUIEditorBase
	{
		public ChartTypeEditor()
			: base(typeof(ChartTypeCtrl))
		{
		}

		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object val)
		{
			if (base.EditorControl.Parent != null)
			{
				RecreateEditorControl();
			}
			base.EditorControl.Width = ChartTypeCtrl.CONTROL_WIDTH;
			ChartTypeCtrl chartTypeCtrl = base.EditorControl as ChartTypeCtrl;
			chartTypeCtrl.SetValue(val);
			chartTypeCtrl.ResetTabs();
			object obj = null;
			if (context != null)
			{
				chartTypeCtrl?.SetComposite(context.Instance is ChartLayerAppearance);
			}
			obj = base.EditValue(context, provider, val);
			chartTypeCtrl?.ResetTabs();
			return obj;
		}
	}

		internal void ShowDialog(IUIService uiService)
		{
			if (uiService != null)
			{
				try
				{
					uiService.ShowDialog(this);
					return;
				}
				catch (NullReferenceException)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			ShowDialog();
		}

		public bool ShowDialogOutOfBox(IComponent component)
		{
			return ShowDialogOutOfBox(component, null);
		}

		internal bool ShowDialogOutOfBox(IComponent component, IUIService uiService)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			string filename = "ChartDesignerSettings";
			Settings = DesignerSettings.Load(filename);
			if (Settings != null)
			{
				flag = Settings.LaunchOnce;
			}
			else
			{
				Settings = new DesignerSettings();
				Settings.LaunchOnce = true;
				Settings.UseDefaultPreset = true;
				Settings.Save(filename);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ShowDialog(component, uiService);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private void ChartWizard_Closing(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)

		}

		public static ChartWizard Create()
		{
			if (ChartWiz == null)
			{
				ChartWiz = new ChartWizard();
			}
			return ChartWiz;
		}

		private void button4_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (Component != null && _RollBackXml != null && _RollBackXml.Length > 0)
			{
				StringReader xtw = new StringReader(_RollBackXml);
				if (Component is Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart)
				{
					((Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart)Component).LoadPreset(xtw, reset: true);
					((Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart)Component).BackgroundImage = _BackgroundImage;
				}
			}
			Close();
		}

		private void button3_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			switch (entryTab.ActiveTab.Index)
			{
			case 1:
				curr_tab--;
				if (curr_tab < 0)
				{
					entryTab.SelectedTab = entryTab.Tabs[0];
					curr_tab = 0;
				}
				SetSelectTab();
				break;
			case 2:
				if (!compositeChartWizardPane1.MovePrevious())
				{
					entryTab.SelectedTab = entryTab.Tabs[0];
				}
				break;
			}
			UpdateStatus();
		}

		private void button2_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			switch (entryTab.ActiveTab.Index)
			{
			case 1:
				curr_tab++;
				if (curr_tab > maxi_tab)
				{
					curr_tab = maxi_tab;
				}
				SetSelectTab();
				break;
			case 2:
				compositeChartWizardPane1.MoveNext();
				break;
			}
			UpdateStatus();
		}

		private void button1_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Close();
			chartWizardPane1.ApplySettings();
			((IChartComponent)_Component).Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			TypeDescriptor.Refresh(_Component);
			IComponentChangeService componentChangeService = (IComponentChangeService)chartWizardPane1.DesignSite.GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService));
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(_Component);
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = properties.Find("ChartType", ignoreCase: false);
			ChartType chartType = (ChartType)propertyDescriptor.GetValue(_Component);
			componentChangeService?.OnComponentChanged(_Component, propertyDescriptor, chartType, chartType);
		}

		private void SetSelectTab()
		{
			chartWizardPane1.SelectedTab = curr_tab;
		}

		public void UpdateStatus()
		{
			if (entryTab.ActiveTab == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (entryTab.ActiveTab.Index)
			{
			case 0:
			{
				UltraButton ultraButton = button2;
				bool enabled = (((Control)(object)button3).Enabled = false);
				((Control)(object)ultraButton).Enabled = enabled;
				Label label2 = lblDialogTitle;
				string text4 = (Text = SR.GetString("WizardEntryText"));
				label2.Text = text4;
				break;
			}
			case 1:
			{
				curr_tab = chartWizardPane1.SelectedTab;
				((Control)(object)button3).Enabled = true;
				((Control)(object)button2).Enabled = curr_tab < maxi_tab;
				Label label3 = lblDialogTitle;
				string text6 = (Text = string.Format(SR.GetString("Wizard_Title_Text"), curr_tab + 1, maxi_tab + 1, chartWizardPane1.SelectedTabTitle));
				label3.Text = text6;
				break;
			}
			case 2:
			{
				((Control)(object)button3).Enabled = true;
				((Control)(object)button2).Enabled = compositeChartWizardPane1.ultraTabControl1.SelectedTab.Index < compositeChartWizardPane1.ultraTabControl1.Tabs.Count - 1;
				string text = "";
				switch (compositeChartWizardPane1.ultraTabControl1.SelectedTab.Index)
				{
				case 0:
					text = SR.GetString("CompositeTitleChartAreas");
					break;
				case 1:
					text = SR.GetString("CompositeTitleAxes");
					break;
				case 2:
					text = SR.GetString("CompositeTitleData");
					break;
				case 3:
					text = SR.GetString("CompositeTitleChartLayers");
					break;
				case 4:
					text = SR.GetString("CompositeTitleLegends");
					break;
				}
				Label label = lblDialogTitle;
				string text2 = (Text = text);
				label.Text = text2;
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private void Form1_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (_Component != null)
			{
				Component = _Component;
				StringWriter stringWriter = new StringWriter();
				if (Component is Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart)
				{
					((Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart)Component).SavePreset(stringWriter, "RollBack", "Roll Back", PresetType.All);
					_BackgroundImage = ((Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart)Component).BackgroundImage;
				}
				_RollBackXml = stringWriter.ToString();
				stringWriter.Close();
			}
			SetSelectTab();
			UpdateStatus();
			chartWizardPane1.WizardForm = this;
			themeSkin = new ThemeSkin((Bitmap)pictureBox4.Image);
			pnlTitle.PE.FillStopColor = Color.FromArgb(10, 62, 152);
			pnlTitle.PE.Fill = Color.FromArgb(88, 134, 213);
			pnlTitle.PE.FillOpacity = byte.MaxValue;
			pnlTitle.PE.FillStopOpacity = byte.MaxValue;
			pnlTitle.PE.FillGradientStyle = GradientStyle.Vertical;
			pnlTitle.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.Gradient;
			SetTheme(themeSkin.Elements[10].Image);
			base.Closing += ChartWizard_Closing;
			((Control)(object)preferencesButton).Visible = true;
			entryTab.SelectedTab = entryTab.Tabs[0];
		}

		private void ReparentControl(Control control, Control newParent, DockStyle dockStyle)
		{
			if (control.Parent != null)
			{
				control.Parent.Controls.Remove(control);
			}
			newParent.Controls.Add(control);
			control.Dock = dockStyle;
		}

		}

		private void entryItems_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{

			{

				compositeChartWizardPane1.SetComponent(chartWizardPane1.ultraChart1);
			}
			UpdateStatus();
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public object Component
		{
			get
			{
				return _Component;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					_Component = value;
					propertyGrid1.Initialize(value as IComponent);
					ultraChart1.ColumnChart.ChartText.Clear();
					ultraChart1.BarChart.ChartText.Clear();
					ultraChart1.AreaChart.ChartText.Clear();
					ultraChart1.LineChart.ChartText.Clear();
					ultraChart1.PieChart.ChartText.Clear();
					ultraChart1.BubbleChart.ChartText.Clear();
					ultraChart1.ScatterChart.ChartText.Clear();
					ultraChart1.HeatMapChart.ChartText.Clear();
					ultraChart1.ProbabilityChart.ChartText.Clear();
					ultraChart1.FunnelChart.ChartText.Clear();
					ultraChart1.PyramidChart.ChartText.Clear();
					if (value.GetType().Namespace.EndsWith("UltraWebChart"))
					{
						_IPropPack = null;
						panel37.Visible = false;
						_WinComponent = false;
						label1.Text = SR.GetString("DS_DataSource_Text1_Web");
					}
					else
					{
						_IPropPack = new WinPropPack((IComponent)_Component);
						propertyGrid1.SelectedObject = _IPropPack;
						panel37.Visible = true;
						_WinComponent = true;
						label1.Text = SR.GetString("DS_DataSource_Text1");
					}
					StringWriter stringWriter = new StringWriter();
					if (_Component is Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart)
					{
						((Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart)_Component).SavePreset(stringWriter, "saved", "saved", PresetType.All);
					}
					string text = "";
					text = stringWriter.GetStringBuilder().ToString();
					StringReader xtw = new StringReader(text);
					ultraChart1.LoadPreset(xtw, reset: true);
					ultraChart1.Data.DataSource = DemoDataSourceForChartType(ultraChart1.ChartType);
					ultraChart1.Data.DataBind();
					if (Component is Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart)
					{
						ultraChart1.BackgroundImage = ((Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart)Component).BackgroundImage;
					}
					GetMargins(_Component as IChartComponent, ultraChart1);
					GetAxisVisibility(_Component as IChartComponent, ultraChart1);
					if (ultraChart1.ChartType != ChartType.Composite)
					{
						freezeChartType = true;
						listBox1.L.SelectedIndex = Array.IndexOf(ChartTypeCtrl.OrderedChartTypes, ultraChart1.ChartType);
						freezeChartType = false;
					}
					listBox2.L.SelectedIndex = (int)ultraChart1.ColorModel.ModelStyle;
					listBox3.L.SelectedIndex = (int)ultraChart1.ColorModel.Scaling;
					listBox4.L.SelectedIndex = 0;
					titleWithFont1.SelectedObject = ultraChart1.TitleTop;
					titleWithFont2.SelectedObject = ultraChart1.TitleBottom;
					titleWithFont3.SelectedObject = ultraChart1.TitleLeft;
					titleWithFont4.SelectedObject = ultraChart1.TitleRight;
					checkBox1.Checked = ultraChart1.Data.SwapRowsAndColumns;
					checkBox2.Checked = ultraChart1.Data.ZeroAligned;
					checkBox4.Checked = ultraChart1.Data.UseRowLabelsColumn;
					numericUpDown1.Value = ultraChart1.Data.RowLabelsColumn;
					DatApp.SetComponent((IChartComponent)_Component);
					showLegend.Checked = (bool)((IChartComponent)_Component).GetProperty("Legend.Visible");
					LegendLocation legendLocation = (LegendLocation)((IChartComponent)_Component).GetProperty("Legend.Location");
					RadioButton radioButton = radioButton1;
					RadioButton radioButton2 = this.radioButton2;
					RadioButton radioButton3 = this.radioButton3;
					bool flag = (radioButton4.Checked = false);
					bool flag3 = (radioButton3.Checked = flag);
					bool flag5 = (radioButton2.Checked = flag3);
					radioButton.Checked = flag5;
					switch (legendLocation)
					{
					case LegendLocation.Left:
						radioButton1.Checked = true;
						break;
					case LegendLocation.Right:
						this.radioButton2.Checked = true;
						break;
					case LegendLocation.Top:
						this.radioButton3.Checked = true;
						break;
					case LegendLocation.Bottom:
						radioButton4.Checked = true;
						break;

					tooltipDisplay = (TooltipDisplay)chartComponent.GetProperty("Tooltips.Display");

					ultraChart1.Tooltips.Display = TooltipDisplay.Never;
					ultraChart1.EnableCrossHair = false;
					UpdateFormatString();
					UpdateCheckboxes();
				}
			}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public ChartTextAppearance DataLabels
		{
			get
			{
				ChartTextAppearance chartTextAppearance = null;
				ChartTextCollection tColl = TColl;
				if (tColl != null)
				{
					foreach (ChartTextAppearance item in tColl)
					{
						if (item.Match(-2, -2))
						{
							chartTextAppearance = item;
							break;
						}
					}
					chartTextAppearance?.SetComponent(ultraChart1);
				}
				return chartTextAppearance;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public ChartTextCollection TColl
		{
			get
			{
				ChartTextCollection result = null;
				try
				{
					ChartType chartType;
					switch (ChartType)
					{
					case ChartType.StackBarChart:
						chartType = ChartType.BarChart;
						break;
					case ChartType.StackColumnChart:
						chartType = ChartType.ColumnChart;
						break;
					case ChartType.HeatMapChart3D:
					case ChartType.PieChart3D:
					case ChartType.Composite:
						return null;
					default:
						chartType = ChartType;
						break;
					}
					string name;
					switch (chartType)
					{
					case ChartType.StepLineChart:
					case ChartType.StepAreaChart:
						name = "LineChart";
						break;
					default:
						name = chartType.ToString();
						break;
					}
					PropertyInfo property = ultraChart1.GetType().GetProperty(name);
					if (property != null)
					{
						object value = property.GetValue(ultraChart1, BindingFlags.GetProperty, null, null, null);
						if (value != null)
						{
							PropertyInfo property2 = value.GetType().GetProperty("ChartText");
							if (property2 != null)
							{
								object value2 = property2.GetValue(value, BindingFlags.GetProperty, null, null, null);
								if (value2 != null)
								{
									result = (ChartTextCollection)value2;
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public ChartType ChartType => ultraChart1.ChartType;

		private void GetMargins(IChartComponent chartComponent, Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart chart)
		{
			if (chart != null && chartComponent != null)
			{
				ChartGridAppearance axis = chart.Axis;
				axis.X.Margin = (AxisMarginAppearance)chartComponent.GetProperty("Axis.X.Margin");

		public void ApplySettings()
		{
			if (!(_Component is IChartComponent chartComponent))
			{
				return;
			}
			ChartTextCollection[] array = new ChartTextCollection[9]
			{
				chartComponent.GetProperty("ColumnChart.ChartText") as ChartTextCollection,
				chartComponent.GetProperty("BarChart.ChartText") as ChartTextCollection,
				chartComponent.GetProperty("AreaChart.ChartText") as ChartTextCollection,
				chartComponent.GetProperty("LineChart.ChartText") as ChartTextCollection,
				chartComponent.GetProperty("PieChart.ChartText") as ChartTextCollection,
				chartComponent.GetProperty("BubbleChart.ChartText") as ChartTextCollection,
				chartComponent.GetProperty("ScatterChart.ChartText") as ChartTextCollection,
				chartComponent.GetProperty("HeatMapChart.ChartText") as ChartTextCollection,
				chartComponent.GetProperty("ProbabilityChart.ChartText") as ChartTextCollection
			};
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array[i] != null)
				{
					array[i].Clear();
				}
			}
			StringWriter stringWriter = new StringWriter();
			ultraChart1.SavePreset(stringWriter, "DesignerGenerated", "Designer Generated Preset", PresetType.All);
			string text = "";
			text = stringWriter.GetStringBuilder().ToString();
			StringReader stringReader = new StringReader(text);
			CompositeChartAppearance compositeChartAppearance = (CompositeChartAppearance)chartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Composite);
			compositeChartAppearance.ChartLayers.Clear();
			compositeChartAppearance.Series.Clear();
			compositeChartAppearance.Legends.Clear();
			MethodInfo method = _Component.GetType().GetMethod("LoadPreset", new Type[2]
			{
				typeof(TextReader),
				typeof(bool)
			});
			method.Invoke(_Component, BindingFlags.InvokeMethod, null, new object[2] { stringReader, true }, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			SetMargins(chartComponent, ultraChart1);
			SetAxisVisibility(chartComponent, ultraChart1);
			if (Component is Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart ultraChart)
			{
				ultraChart.BackgroundImage = ultraChart1.BackgroundImage;
				foreach (ISeries item in ultraChart.Series)
				{
					ISeries series2 = ultraChart1.Series.FromKey(item.Key);
					if (series2 != null)
					{
						item.PEs.Clear();
						item.PEs.AddRange(series2.PEs.Clone().ToArray());
					}
				}
			}
			chartComponent.SetProperty("Tooltips.Display", tooltipDisplay);
			chartComponent.SetProperty("EnableCrossHair", enableCrossHair);
			if (_IPropPack != null)
			{
				_Component.GetType().InvokeMember("DataSource", BindingFlags.SetProperty, null, _Component, new object[1] { _IPropPack.DataSource });
				_Component.GetType().InvokeMember("DataMember", BindingFlags.SetProperty, null, _Component, new object[1] { _IPropPack.DataMember });
			}
		}

		private object CreateSurrogateDataSource(object datasource, string dataMember, CurrencyManager cm, string relationName)
		{
			DataTable dataTable = null;
			DataTable dataTable2 = null;
			if (datasource is DataTable)
			{
				dataTable = new DataTable(((DataTable)datasource).TableName);
				dataTable2 = (DataTable)datasource;
			}
			else if (datasource is DataSet)
			{
				dataTable = ((dataMember == null) ? new DataTable(((DataSet)datasource).Tables[0].TableName) : new DataTable(dataMember));
				dataTable2 = ((DataSet)datasource).Tables[0];
			}
			if (dataTable != null && dataTable2 != null)
			{
				int count = dataTable2.Columns.Count;
				if (count > 0)
				{
					foreach (DataColumn column in dataTable2.Columns)
					{
						dataTable.Columns.Add(column.ColumnName, column.DataType);
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
					{
						object[] array = new object[count];
						for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
						{
							DataColumn dataColumn2 = dataTable.Columns[j];
							object[] array2;
							if ((array2 = (object[])surrogateTableData[dataColumn2.DataType.FullName]) != null)
							{
								if (array2[i] is int)
								{
									array[j] = (int)array2[i] + rng.Next(30);
								}
								else
								{
									array[j] = array2[i];
								}
							}
						}
						dataTable.Rows.Add(array);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					dataTable = null;
				}
			}
			return dataTable;
		}

		public void GiveChart(Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart chart)
		{
			if (ultraChart1.Parent != panel7)
			{
				ultraChart1.Parent.Controls.Remove(ultraChart1);
				panel7.Controls.Add(ultraChart1);
			}
		}

		private void ChartWizardPane_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			panel7.Controls.Add(ultraChart1);
			ultraChart1.Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
			panel47.Controls.AddRange(new Control[1] { (Control)(object)axisWizardTabControl });
			gridControl1.Grid = ultraChart1.Axis;
		}

		public void InitWizardEvents()
		{
			((Control)(object)ultraButton1).Text = SR.GetString("Button_Reset_Text");
			chartImages = ChartTypeCtrl.ChartImagesSkin;
			chartImages.MakeTransparent(Color.White);
			listBox1.L.SelectedIndexChanged += listBox1_SelectedIndexChanged;
			listBox1.L.DrawMode = DrawMode.OwnerDrawFixed;
			listBox1.L.ItemHeight = 48;
			listBox1.L.DrawItem += listBox1_DrawItem;
			listBox2.L.SelectedIndexChanged += listBox2_SelectedIndexChanged;
			listBox2.L.DrawMode = DrawMode.OwnerDrawFixed;
			listBox2.L.DrawItem += Gradient_DrawItem;
			listBox3.L.SelectedIndexChanged += listBox3_SelectedIndexChanged;
			listBox3.L.DrawMode = DrawMode.OwnerDrawFixed;
			listBox3.L.DrawItem += Gradient_DrawItem;
			listBox4.L.SelectedIndexChanged += listBox4_SelectedIndexChanged;
			listBox4.L.DrawMode = DrawMode.OwnerDrawFixed;
			listBox4.L.DrawItem += Gradient_DrawItem;
			ListBox l = listBox2.L;
			ListBox l2 = listBox3.L;
			int num = (listBox4.L.ItemHeight = 18);
			int itemHeight = (l2.ItemHeight = num);
			l.ItemHeight = itemHeight;
			ListBox l3 = listBox2.L;
			ListBox l4 = listBox3.L;
			Font font = (listBox4.L.Font = new Font("Trebuchet MS", 9f));
			Font font3 = (l4.Font = font);
			l3.Font = font3;
			roundRectGroupBox2.PE.Fill = Color.WhiteSmoke;
		}

		private void listBox1_DrawItem(object sender, DrawItemEventArgs e)
		{
			render.G = e.Graphics;
			ListBox listBox = (ListBox)sender;
			Rectangle bounds = e.Bounds;
			bounds.Width -= 5;
			b1.rect = bounds;
			b2.rect = bounds;
			b2.rect.Width = b2.rect.Height;
			Brush brush = new SolidBrush(listBox.BackColor);
			e.Graphics.FillRectangle(brush, e.Bounds);
			brush.Dispose();
			int num = 0;
			br = br1;
			if ((e.State & DrawItemState.Selected) > DrawItemState.None)
			{
				render.Draw(b1);
				num = 112;
				br = br2;
			}
			else if ((e.State & DrawItemState.HotLight) > DrawItemState.None)
			{
				num = 56;
				e.Graphics.DrawRectangle(Pens.Red, bounds);
			}
			int num2 = ((ChartTypeCtrl.ChartIconInfo)ChartTypeCtrl.ChartIconInfoTable[ChartTypeCtrl.OrderedChartTypes[e.Index]]).SkinIndex + num;
			Bitmap image = chartImages.Elements[num2].Image;
			image.MakeTransparent(Color.White);
			e.Graphics.DrawImage(image, e.Bounds.Location.X + 4, e.Bounds.Location.Y);
			string s = listBox1.L.Items[e.Index].ToString();
			SizeF sizeF = e.Graphics.MeasureString(s, listBox1.Font);
			int num3 = (int)(((float)bounds.Height - sizeF.Height) / 2f);
			e.Graphics.DrawString(s, listBox1.Font, br, bounds.Height + bounds.X + 4, bounds.Y + num3);
		}

		private void Gradient_DrawItem(object sender, DrawItemEventArgs e)
		{
			ListBox listBox = (ListBox)sender;
			render.G = e.Graphics;
			Rectangle bounds = e.Bounds;
			b1.rect = bounds;
			Brush brush = new SolidBrush(listBox.BackColor);
			e.Graphics.FillRectangle(brush, e.Bounds);
			brush.Dispose();
			br = br1;
			if ((e.State & DrawItemState.Selected) > DrawItemState.None)
			{
				render.Draw(b1);
				br = br2;
			}
			else if ((e.State & DrawItemState.Disabled) > DrawItemState.None)
			{
				br = br3;
			}
			string s = listBox.Items[e.Index].ToString();
			SizeF sizeF = e.Graphics.MeasureString(s, listBox.Font);
			int num = (int)(((float)bounds.Height - sizeF.Height) / 2f);
			e.Graphics.DrawString(s, listBox.Font, br, bounds.X + 4, bounds.Y + num);
		}

		private void Gradient_DrawItem1(object sender, DrawItemEventArgs e)
		{
			TabControl tabControl = (TabControl)sender;
			render.G = e.Graphics;
			Rectangle bounds = e.Bounds;
			bounds.Inflate(1, 1);
			b3.rect = bounds;
			b2.rect = bounds;
			Brush brush = new SolidBrush(tabControl.BackColor);
			e.Graphics.FillRectangle(brush, e.Bounds);
			brush.Dispose();
			br = br1;
			if ((e.State & DrawItemState.Selected) > DrawItemState.None)
			{
				render.Draw(b3);
				br = br2;
			}
			else
			{
				if (e.Index == tabControl.TabCount - 1)
				{
					b2.rect = new Rectangle(bounds.X - 1, bounds.Y, bounds.Width + 300, bounds.Height + 5);
				}
				else
				{
					b2.rect = new Rectangle(bounds.X - 1, bounds.Y, bounds.Width + 2, bounds.Height + 5);
				}
				render.Draw(b2);
			}
			string s = tabControl.TabPages[e.Index].Text;
			SizeF sizeF = e.Graphics.MeasureString(s, tabControl.Font);
			int num = (int)(((float)bounds.Height - sizeF.Height) / 2f);
			e.Graphics.DrawString(s, tabControl.Font, br, bounds.X + 4, bounds.Y + num);
		}

		private void tabControl1_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			newLabelControl1.Text1 = SelectedTabTitle;
			if (tabControl1.SelectedTab.Name.Equals("charttype"))
			{
				ChartType selectedIndex = (ChartType)listBox1.L.SelectedIndex;
				newLabelControl1.Text2 = SR.GetString("Description_" + selectedIndex);
			}
			else
			{
				newLabelControl1.Text2 = SR.GetString("Tab_Description_" + tabControl1.SelectedTab.Name);
			}
			switch (tabControl1.SelectedTab.Name)
			{
			case "charttype":
				panel20.Controls.Add(panel6);
				break;
			case "chartdata":
				if (!_WinComponent)
				{
					newLabelControl1.Text2 = SR.GetString("Tab_Description_" + tabControl1.SelectedTab.Name + "_web");
				}
				panel15.Controls.Add(panel6);
				break;
			case "legend":
				panel59.Controls.Add(panel6);
				break;
			case "charttitle":
				panel23.Controls.Add(panel6);
				break;
			case "axes":
				panel44.Controls.Add(panel6);
				break;
			case "colormodel":
				panel36.Controls.Add(panel6);
				break;
			case "datalabels":
				panel65.Controls.Add(panel6);
				break;
			}
			_WizardForm.UpdateStatus();
			colorBeginEditor.Color = ultraChart1.ColorModel.ColorBegin;
			colorEndEditor.Color = ultraChart1.ColorModel.ColorEnd;
		}

		private void listBox2_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ColorModels selectedIndex = (ColorModels)listBox2.L.SelectedIndex;
			newLabelControl7.Text1 = selectedIndex.ToString();
			bool flag;
			switch (selectedIndex)
			{
			case ColorModels.CustomLinear:
			case ColorModels.CustomRandom:
			case ColorModels.DataValueCustomLinear:
				flag = false;
				newLabelControl7.Text2 = string.Format(SR.GetString("DS_ColorModel_Text3_1"), selectedIndex.ToString());
				break;
			case ColorModels.Wireframe:
				flag = false;
				newLabelControl7.Text2 = string.Format(SR.GetString("DS_ColorModel_Text3_2"), selectedIndex.ToString());
				break;
			case ColorModels.CustomSkin:
				flag = false;
				newLabelControl7.Text2 = string.Format(SR.GetString("DS_ColorModel_Text3_3"), selectedIndex.ToString());
				break;
			case ColorModels.PureRandom:
				flag = false;
				newLabelControl7.Text2 = string.Format(SR.GetString("DS_ColorModel_Text3_4"), selectedIndex.ToString());
				break;
			default:
				flag = true;
				newLabelControl7.Text2 = string.Format(SR.GetString("DS_ColorModel_Text3"), selectedIndex.ToString());
				break;
			}
			ultraChart1.ColorModel.ModelStyle = selectedIndex;
			if (!flag)
			{
				newLabelControl8.Text2 = SR.GetString("DS_ColorModel_Text4_1_1");
				newLabelControl9.Text2 = SR.GetString("DS_ColorModel_Text5_1_1");
				roundRectGroupBox4.Enabled = false;
			}
			else
			{
				newLabelControl8.Text2 = SR.GetString("DS_ColorModel_Text4_1");
				newLabelControl9.Text2 = SR.GetString("DS_ColorModel_Text5_1");
				roundRectGroupBox4.Enabled = true;
				UltraColorPicker ultraColorPicker = colorEndEditor;
				bool enabled = (newLabelControl9.Enabled = ultraChart1.ColorModel.ModelStyle != ColorModels.Office2007Style);
				((Control)(object)ultraColorPicker).Enabled = enabled;
			}
			switch (selectedIndex)
			{
			case ColorModels.Wireframe:
			case ColorModels.DataValueCustomLinear:
			case ColorModels.DataValueLinearRange:
			case ColorModels.Office2007Style:
				listBox3.Enabled = false;
				break;
			default:
				listBox3.Enabled = true;
				break;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFormatString()
		{
			formatString[0] = ultraChart1.Axis.X.Labels.ItemFormatString;
			formatString[1] = ultraChart1.Axis.Y.Labels.ItemFormatString;
			formatString[2] = ultraChart1.Axis.Z.Labels.ItemFormatString;
			formatString[3] = ultraChart1.Axis.X2.Labels.ItemFormatString;
			formatString[4] = ultraChart1.Axis.Y2.Labels.ItemFormatString;
			formatString[5] = ultraChart1.Axis.Z2.Labels.ItemFormatString;
			formatString[6] = ultraChart1.PieChart.Labels.FormatString;
		}

		private object DemoDataSourceForChartType(ChartType type)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case ChartType.ProbabilityChart:
				return DemoTable.Table(8);
			case ChartType.CandleChart:
			case ChartType.StepLineChart:
			case ChartType.StepAreaChart:
				return DemoTable.Table(1);
			case ChartType.GanttChart:
				return DemoTable.Table(4);
			case ChartType.PolarChart:
				return DemoTable.Table(5);
			case ChartType.BoxChart:
				return DemoTable.BoxChartData;
			case ChartType.BubbleChart3D:
				return new double[7, 4]
				{
					{ 45.0, 50.0, 38.0, 18.0 },
					{ 60.0, 80.0, 35.0, 4.0 },
					{ 45.0, 50.0, 67.0, 7.0 },
					{ 60.0, 90.0, 46.0, 2.0 },
					{ 65.0, 50.0, 74.0, 25.0 },
					{ 70.0, 30.0, 26.0, 7.0 },
					{ 20.0, 34.0, 67.0, 3.0 }
				};
			default:
				return DemoTable.AllPositive();
			}
		}

		private void listBox1_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)cmdUnbindFromDataSource2).Text = SR.GetString("LD_Bind");
			ChartType chartType = ChartTypeCtrl.OrderedChartTypes[listBox1.L.SelectedIndex];
			NumericUpDown numericUpDown = numericUpDown1;
			Label label = this.label2;
			CheckBox checkBox = checkBox1;
			bool flag = (checkBox4.Enabled = true);
			bool flag3 = (checkBox.Enabled = flag);
			bool enabled = (label.Enabled = flag3);
			numericUpDown.Enabled = enabled;
			ultraChart1.Data.DataSource = DemoDataSourceForChartType(chartType);
			ultraChart1.Data.DataBind();
			switch (chartType)
			{
			case ChartType.CandleChart:
			case ChartType.StepLineChart:
			case ChartType.StepAreaChart:
			{
				checkBox1.Checked = false;
				checkBox4.Checked = false;
				numericUpDown1.Value = -1m;
				NumericUpDown numericUpDown2 = numericUpDown1;
				Label label4 = this.label2;
				CheckBox checkBox2 = checkBox1;
				bool flag8 = (checkBox4.Enabled = false);
				bool flag10 = (checkBox2.Enabled = flag8);
				bool enabled4 = (label4.Enabled = flag10);
				numericUpDown2.Enabled = enabled4;
				break;
			}
			case ChartType.ColumnChart:
			case ChartType.BarChart:
			case ChartType.AreaChart:
			case ChartType.LineChart:
			case ChartType.PieChart:
			case ChartType.BubbleChart:
			case ChartType.ScatterChart:
			case ChartType.HeatMapChart:
			case ChartType.StackBarChart:
			case ChartType.StackColumnChart:
			case ChartType.ProbabilityChart:
			case ChartType.FunnelChart:
			case ChartType.PyramidChart:
			{
				Label label3 = this.label4;
				bool enabled3 = (checkBox9.Enabled = true);
				label3.Enabled = enabled3;
				this.label4.Text = SR.GetString("DS_DataLabels_Text");
				break;
			}
			default:
			{
				Label label2 = this.label4;
				bool enabled2 = (checkBox9.Enabled = false);
				label2.Enabled = enabled2;
				this.label4.Text = SR.GetString("DS_DataLabels_Text_NotApplicable");
				break;
			}
			}
			switch (chartType)
			{
			case ChartType.BubbleChart:
			case ChartType.ScatterChart:
			case ChartType.CandleChart:
			case ChartType.StepLineChart:
			case ChartType.StepAreaChart:
			case ChartType.ProbabilityChart:
				checkBox4.Checked = false;
				checkBox4.Enabled = false;
				break;
			default:
				checkBox4.Enabled = true;
				break;
			}
			if (!freezeChartType)
			{
				ultraChart1.ChartType = chartType;
				ultraChart1.Axis.X.Labels.Visible = ultraChart1.Axis.X.Visible;
				ultraChart1.Axis.Y.Labels.Visible = ultraChart1.Axis.Y.Visible;
				ultraChart1.Axis.Z.Labels.Visible = ultraChart1.Axis.Z.Visible;
				ultraChart1.Axis.X2.Labels.Visible = ultraChart1.Axis.X2.Visible;
				ultraChart1.Axis.Y2.Labels.Visible = ultraChart1.Axis.Y2.Visible;
				ultraChart1.Axis.Z2.Labels.Visible = ultraChart1.Axis.Z2.Visible;
			}
			if (chartType == ChartType.GanttChart)
			{
				checkBox1.Checked = false;
			}
			checkBox1.Enabled = chartType != ChartType.GanttChart;
			axisWizardTabControl.Tabs[1].Visible = chartType != ChartType.PieChart && chartType != ChartType.PieChart3D && chartType != ChartType.PolarChart && chartType != ChartType.RadarChart && chartType != ChartType.DoughnutChart && chartType != ChartType.DoughnutChart3D && chartType != ChartType.FunnelChart && chartType != ChartType.PyramidChart && chartType.ToString().IndexOf("3D") < 0;
			UpdateFormatString();
			if (chartType.ToString().ToLower().IndexOf("stack") > -1)
			{
				((IChartComponent)ultraChart1).GetProperty("Stack");
			}
			else
			{
				((IChartComponent)ultraChart1).GetProperty(chartType.ToString());
			}
			listBox4.L.Items.Clear();
			listBox4.L.Items.AddRange(mAxesName[(int)chartType]);
			listBox4.L.SelectedIndex = 0;
			UpdateCheckboxes();
			newLabelControl1.Text1 = SR.GetString("SR_" + chartType);
			if (newLabelControl1.Text1 == null || newLabelControl1.Text1.Length == 0)
			{
				newLabelControl1.Text1 = chartType.ToString().Replace("Chart", " Chart").Replace("3D", " 3D");
			}
			newLabelControl1.Text2 = SR.GetString("Description_" + chartType);
		}

			LoadAxesSettings();
		}

				roundRectGroupBox3.Enabled = false;
			}
		}

		private void cmdUnbindFromDataSource2_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (((Control)(object)cmdUnbindFromDataSource2).Text.Equals(SR.GetString("LD_Bind")))
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdUnbindFromDataSource2).Text = SR.GetString("LD_Unbind");
				ultraChart1.DataSource = CreateSurrogateDataSource(_IPropPack.DataSource, _IPropPack.DataMember, null, null);
				ultraChart1.DataMember = _IPropPack.DataMember;
				ultraChart1.Data.DataBind();
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)cmdUnbindFromDataSource2).Text = SR.GetString("LD_Bind");
				listBox1_SelectedIndexChanged(null, null);
			}
		}

		private void InitLabelsSection()
		{
			datValFormat = new Regex("<\\s*DATA_VALUE\\s*(:.+)?\\s*>");
			rowLabelFormat = new Regex("<\\s*ROW_LABEL\\s*(:.+)?\\s*>");
			colLabelFormat = new Regex("<\\s*COLUMN_LABEL\\s*(:.+)?\\s*>");
			percentFormat = new Regex("<\\s*PERCENT_VALUE\\s*(:.+)?\\s*>%");
			UpdateCheckboxes();
		}

		private void UpdateCheckboxes()
		{
			checkBox9.Checked = DataLabels != null;
			if (checkBox9.Checked)
			{
				FormatString = DataLabels.ItemFormatString;
				Label label = label4;
				bool enabled = (checkBox9.Enabled = TColl != null);
				label.Enabled = enabled;
			}
			if (label4.Enabled)
			{
				label4.Text = SR.GetString("DS_DataLabels_Text");
			}
			else
			{
				label4.Text = SR.GetString("DS_DataLabels_Text_NotApplicable");
			}
		}

		private void UpdateChartText()
		{
			ChartTextCollection tColl = TColl;
			ChartTextAppearance chartTextAppearance = DataLabels;
			if (checkBox9.Checked)
			{
				if (chartTextAppearance == null)
				{
					chartTextAppearance = new ChartTextAppearance();
					chartTextAppearance.SetComponent(ultraChart1);
					chartTextAppearance.Row = -2;
					chartTextAppearance.Column = -2;
				}
				chartTextAppearance.ItemFormatString = "<DATA_VALUE:00.00>";
				chartTextAppearance.Visible = true;
				if (tColl != null)
				{
					ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
					foreach (ChartTextAppearance item2 in tColl)
					{
						if (item2.Match(chartTextAppearance.Row, chartTextAppearance.Column))
						{
							arrayList.Add(item2);
						}
					}
					foreach (ChartTextAppearance item3 in arrayList)
					{
						tColl.Remove(item3);
					}
					if (checkBox9.Checked)
					{
						tColl.Add(chartTextAppearance);
					}
				}
				((IChartComponent)ultraChart1).Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
			else if (chartTextAppearance != null)
			{
				tColl.Remove(chartTextAppearance);
			}
		}

		private void axisWizardTabControl_SelectedTabChanged(object sender, SelectedTabChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (axisWizardTabControl.SelectedTab == axisWizardTabControl.Tabs[0])
			{
				label5.Text = SR.GetString("DS_CorrectFormatString");
			}
			else if (axisWizardTabControl.SelectedTab == axisWizardTabControl.Tabs[1])
			{
				label5.Text = SR.GetString("DS_AdjustGrid");
			}
		}
	}

		private void cancelButton_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Close();
		}

		private void okButton_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (ChartWizard.Settings != null)
			{
				ChartWizard.Settings.LaunchOnce = ultraCheckEditor1.Checked;
				ChartWizard.Settings.UseDefaultPreset = ultraCheckEditor2.Checked;
				if (((Control)(object)defaultPresetPathEditor).Text != null && ((Control)(object)defaultPresetPathEditor).Text.Length > 0 && ((Control)(object)defaultPresetPathEditor).Text != _InfragisticsDefaultString)
				{
					ChartWizard.Settings.DefaultPresetPath = ((Control)(object)defaultPresetPathEditor).Text;
				}
				else
				{
					ChartWizard.Settings.DefaultPresetPath = "";
				}
				new MessageBox().MessageBoxShow(SR.GetString("SR_CHANGESWILLTAKEEFFECT"), "");
				ChartWizard.Settings.Save("ChartDesignerSettings");
			}
			Close();
		}

		private void ChartWizardPreferencesForm_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0074: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((Control)(object)ultraCheckEditor1).Text = SR.GetString("SR_AUTOSHOWCHARTWIZARD");
			((Control)(object)okButton).Text = SR.GetString("SR_OK");
			((Control)(object)cancelButton).Text = SR.GetString("SR_Cancel");
			((Control)(object)ultraCheckEditor2).Text = SR.GetString("SR_USEDEFAULTPRESETFILE");
			Text = SR.GetString("SR_Preferences");
			EditorButton val = new EditorButton("browse");
			EditorButton val2 = new EditorButton("reset");
			((KeyedSubObjectBase)(object)val).Key = "browse";
			((KeyedSubObjectBase)(object)val2).Key = "reset";
			val.Text = "...";
			val2.Text = SR.GetString("Button_Reset_Text");
			((EditorButtonControlBase)defaultPresetPathEditor).ButtonsRight.Add((EditorButtonBase)(object)val);
			((EditorButtonControlBase)defaultPresetPathEditor).ButtonsRight.Add((EditorButtonBase)(object)val2);
			base.Width++;
			((UltraControlBase)defaultPresetPathEditor).Invalidate();
			if (ChartWizard.Settings == null)
			{
				ChartWizard.Settings = DesignerSettings.Load("ChartDesignerSettings");
			}
			if (ChartWizard.Settings != null)
			{
				ultraCheckEditor1.Checked = ChartWizard.Settings.LaunchOnce;
				ultraCheckEditor2.Checked = ChartWizard.Settings.UseDefaultPreset;
				if (ChartWizard.Settings.DefaultPresetPath != null && ChartWizard.Settings.DefaultPresetPath.Length > 0)
				{
					((Control)(object)defaultPresetPathEditor).Text = ChartWizard.Settings.DefaultPresetPath;
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)defaultPresetPathEditor).Text = _InfragisticsDefaultString;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UltraTextEditor ultraTextEditor = defaultPresetPathEditor;
				UltraCheckEditor ultraCheckEditor = ultraCheckEditor2;
				bool flag = (((Control)(object)ultraCheckEditor1).Enabled = false);
				bool enabled = (((Control)(object)ultraCheckEditor).Enabled = flag);
				((Control)(object)ultraTextEditor).Enabled = enabled;
			}
			((EditorButtonControlBase)defaultPresetPathEditor).ButtonsRight["reset"].Visible = ((Control)(object)defaultPresetPathEditor).Text != _InfragisticsDefaultString;
		}

		private void defaultPresetPathEditor_EditorButtonClick(object sender, EditorButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (((KeyedSubObjectBase)(object)e.Button).Key)
			{
			case "browse":
			{
				OpenFileDialog openFileDialog = new OpenFileDialog();
				openFileDialog.Filter = "XML Files (*.xml)|*.xml|All Files (*.*)|*.*";
				if (openFileDialog.ShowDialog() != DialogResult.Cancel)
				{
					((Control)(object)defaultPresetPathEditor).Text = openFileDialog.FileName;
				}
				((EditorButtonControlBase)defaultPresetPathEditor).ButtonsRight["reset"].Visible = ((Control)(object)defaultPresetPathEditor).Text != _InfragisticsDefaultString;
				break;
			}
			case "reset":
				((Control)(object)defaultPresetPathEditor).Text = _InfragisticsDefaultString;
				break;
			}
		}

		private void defaultPresetPathEditor_BeforeEnterEditMode(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((Control)(object)defaultPresetPathEditor).Text == _InfragisticsDefaultString)
			{
				((Control)(object)defaultPresetPathEditor).Text = "";
			}
		}

		private void defaultPresetPathEditor_AfterExitEditMode(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (((Control)(object)defaultPresetPathEditor).Text == null || ((Control)(object)defaultPresetPathEditor).Text.Length == 0)
			{
				((Control)(object)defaultPresetPathEditor).Text = _InfragisticsDefaultString;
			}
		}
	}

		internal void SetComponent(Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart chart)
		{
			ultraChart1 = chart;
			if (chart.Parent != null)
			{
				chart.Parent.Controls.Remove(chart);
			}
			chartPanel.Controls.Add(chart);
			chart.Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
			ultraChart1.ChartType = ChartType.Composite;
			Util.PopulateItems((IList)chartLayerChartAreaEditor.Items, ultraChart1.CompositeChart.ChartAreas);
			Util.PopulateItems(chartLayerSeriesListBox.L.Items, ultraChart1.CompositeChart.Series);
			Util.PopulateItems(chartAreasListBox.L.Items, ultraChart1.CompositeChart.ChartAreas);
			if (chartAreasListBox.L.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				chartAreasListBox.L.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
			Util.PopulateItems(chartLayersListBox.L.Items, ultraChart1.CompositeChart.ChartLayers);
			if (chartLayersListBox.L.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				chartLayersListBox.L.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
			Util.PopulateItems(seriesListBox.L.Items, ultraChart1.CompositeChart.Series);
			if (seriesListBox.L.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				seriesListBox.L.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
			if (chartLayersListBox.L.SelectedItem is ChartLayerAppearance chartLayerAppearance)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < chartLayerSeriesListBox.L.Items.Count; i++)
				{
					bool value = chartLayerSeriesListBox.L.Items[i] is ISeries obj && chartLayerAppearance.Series.Contains(obj);
					chartLayerSeriesListBox.L.SetSelected(i, value);
				}
			}
			Util.PopulateItems(legendsListbox.L.Items, ultraChart1.CompositeChart.Legends);
			if (legendsListbox.L.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				legendsListbox.L.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
			if (legendsListbox.L.SelectedItem is CompositeLegend compositeLegend)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < legendChartLayersListBox.L.Items.Count; j++)
				{
					bool value2 = legendChartLayersListBox.L.Items[j] is ChartLayerAppearance layer && compositeLegend.ChartLayers.Contains(layer);
					legendChartLayersListBox.L.SetSelected(j, value2);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && components != null)
			{
				components.Dispose();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		private void ultraGrid1_InitializeLayout(object sender, InitializeLayoutEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Layout.Bands.Count <= 0 || e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["Label"] == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["Label"].Header.VisiblePosition = 0;
			if (e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("Value"))
			{
				e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["Value"].Header.VisiblePosition = 1;
			}
			else if (e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("ValueX"))
			{
				e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["ValueX"].Header.VisiblePosition = 1;
				if (e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("ValueY"))
				{
					e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["ValueY"].Header.VisiblePosition = 2;
					if (e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("ValueZ"))
					{
						e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["ValueZ"].Header.VisiblePosition = 3;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("NumericValue"))
			{
				e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["NumericValue"].Header.VisiblePosition = 1;
				if (e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("TimeValue"))
				{
					e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["TimeValue"].Header.VisiblePosition = 2;
				}
			}
			else if (e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("Date"))
			{
				e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["Date"].Header.VisiblePosition = 1;
				if (!e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("Open"))
				{
					return;
				}
				e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["Open"].Header.VisiblePosition = 2;
				if (e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("Close"))
				{
					e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["Close"].Header.VisiblePosition = 3;
				}
				if (!e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("High"))
				{
					return;
				}
				e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["High"].Header.VisiblePosition = 4;
				if (e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("Low"))
				{
					e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["Low"].Header.VisiblePosition = 5;
					if (e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("Volume"))
					{
						e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["Volume"].Header.VisiblePosition = 6;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("Min"))
				{
					return;
				}
				e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["Min"].Header.VisiblePosition = 0;
				if (!e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("Max"))
				{
					return;
				}
				e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["Max"].Header.VisiblePosition = 1;
				if (!e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("Q1"))
				{
					return;
				}
				e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["Q1"].Header.VisiblePosition = 2;
				if (e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("Q2"))
				{
					e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["Q2"].Header.VisiblePosition = 3;
					if (e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns.Exists("Q3"))
					{
						e.Layout.Bands[0].Columns["Q3"].Header.VisiblePosition = 4;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void CompositeChartWizardPane_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_009f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0103: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			chartLayerSeriesListBox.L.SelectionMode = SelectionMode.MultiSimple;
			legendChartLayersListBox.L.SelectionMode = SelectionMode.MultiSimple;
			Util.AddEnumValues(typeof(AxisDataType), axisDataTypeEditor.Items);
			Util.AddEnumValues(typeof(SetLabelAxisType), axisSetLabelAxisTypeEditor.Items);
			Util.AddEnumValues(typeof(AxisNumber), axisOrientationEditor.Items);
			Util.AddEnumValues(typeof(ChartType), chartLayerChartTypeEditor.Items);
			((PopupMenuTool)((ToolsCollectionBase)ultraToolbarsManager1.Tools)["addSeriesPopupMenuTool"]).Tools.AddToolRange(new string[7] { "addNumericSeriesButtonTool", "addXYSeriesButtonTool", "addXYZSeriesButtonTool", "addNumericTimeSeriesButtonTool", "addCandleSeriesButtonTool", "addGanttSeriesButtonTool", "addBoxSetSeriesButtonTool" });
			((PopupMenuTool)((ToolsCollectionBase)ultraToolbarsManager1.Tools)["addAxisPopupMenuTool"]).Tools.AddToolRange(new string[4] { "addXAxisButtonTool", "addYAxisButtonTool", "addX2AxisButtonTool", "addY2AxisButtonTool" });
			((Control)(object)axisExtentEditor).MouseWheel += editors_MouseWheel;
			Attribute[] array = new Attribute[chartAreaPEPropertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes.Count + 1];
			chartAreaPEPropertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes.CopyTo(array, 0);
			array[array.Length - 1] = new WizardBrowsableAttribute(browsable: true);
			chartAreaPEPropertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes = new AttributeCollection(array);
		}

		private void ultraTabControl1_SelectedTabChanged(object sender, SelectedTabChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			int index = ultraTabControl1.SelectedTab.Index;
			if (index == 1 && chartAreasListBox.L.SelectedItem is ChartArea chartArea)
			{
				((Control)(object)compositeChartAxesTabLabel).Text = SR.GetString("CompositeChartWizard_Axes_Tab_Text") + " " + chartArea.Key;
			}
			if (this.SelectedTabChanged != null)
			{
				this.SelectedTabChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void BlinkPE(PaintElement peToBlink)
		{
			PaintElementType elementType = peToBlink.ElementType;
			Color fill = peToBlink.Fill;
			byte fillOpacity = peToBlink.FillOpacity;
			for (int i = 0; i < 1; i++)
			{
				peToBlink.ElementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill;
				peToBlink.Fill = Color.Yellow;
				peToBlink.FillOpacity = 150;
				ultraChart1.InvalidateLayers();
				Invalidate();
				if (this.Updated != null)
				{
					this.Updated(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
				Application.DoEvents();
				Thread.Sleep(100);
				peToBlink.ElementType = elementType;
				peToBlink.Fill = fill;
				peToBlink.FillOpacity = fillOpacity;
				ultraChart1.InvalidateLayers();
				Invalidate();
				if (this.Updated != null)
				{
					this.Updated(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
				Application.DoEvents();
				Thread.Sleep(100);
			}
		}

		private void SyncChartAreaControls()
		{
			bool flag = noUpdateChart;
			noUpdateChart = true;
			if (chartAreasListBox.L.SelectedItem is ChartArea chartArea)
			{
				chartAreaBoundsEditor.SelectedBounds = chartArea.Bounds;
				chartAreaBoundsEditor.BoundsMeasureType = chartArea.BoundsMeasureType;
				chartAreaPEPropertyGrid.SelectedObject = chartArea.PE;
				Util.PopulateItems(axesListBox.L.Items, chartArea.Axes);
			}
			else
			{
				axesListBox.L.Items.Clear();
			}
			noUpdateChart = flag;
		}

		private void SyncAxisControls()
		{
			bool flag = noUpdateChart;
			noUpdateChart = true;
			if (axesListBox.L.SelectedItem is AxisItem axisItem)
			{
				axisExtentEditor.Value = axisItem.Extent;
				switch (axisItem.OrientationType)
				{
				case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
					axisOrientationEditor.SelectedIndex = 0;
					break;
				case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
					axisOrientationEditor.SelectedIndex = 1;
					break;
				case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
					axisOrientationEditor.SelectedIndex = 2;
					break;
				case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
					axisOrientationEditor.SelectedIndex = 3;
					break;
				}
				axisItemLabelsPropertyGrid.SelectedObject = axisItem.Labels;
				axisSeriesLabelsPropertyGrid.SelectedObject = axisItem.Labels.SeriesLabels;
				axisDataTypeEditor.SelectedIndex = axisDataTypeEditor.FindString(axisItem.DataType.ToString());
				axisSetLabelAxisTypeEditor.SelectedIndex = axisSetLabelAxisTypeEditor.FindString(axisItem.SetLabelAxisType.ToString());
				axisSmartTicksEditor.Checked = axisItem.TickmarkStyle == AxisTickStyle.Smart;
				UltraComboEditor ultraComboEditor = axisSetLabelAxisTypeEditor;
				bool visible = (((Control)(object)axisSetLabelAxisTypeLabel).Visible = axisItem.DataType == AxisDataType.String);
				((Control)(object)ultraComboEditor).Visible = visible;
			}
			noUpdateChart = flag;
		}

		private void SyncChartLayerControls()
		{
			bool flag = noUpdateChart;
			noUpdateChart = true;
			if (chartLayersListBox.L.SelectedItem is ChartLayerAppearance chartLayerAppearance)
			{
				chartLayerChartTypeEditor.SelectedIndex = chartLayerChartTypeEditor.FindString(chartLayerAppearance.ChartType.ToString());
				chartLayerChartTypeAppearancePropertyGrid.SelectedObject = chartLayerAppearance.ChartTypeAppearance;
				if (chartLayerAppearance.ChartArea != null)
				{
					chartLayerChartAreaEditor.SelectedIndex = chartLayerChartAreaEditor.FindString(chartLayerAppearance.ChartArea.Key);
					chartLayerAxisXEditor.SelectedIndex = chartLayerAxisXEditor.FindString(chartLayerAppearance.AxisXKey);
					chartLayerAxisYEditor.SelectedIndex = chartLayerAxisYEditor.FindString(chartLayerAppearance.AxisYKey);
					chartLayerAxisY2Editor.SelectedIndex = chartLayerAxisY2Editor.FindString(chartLayerAppearance.AxisY2Key);
				}
				else
				{
					UltraComboEditor ultraComboEditor = chartLayerAxisXEditor;
					UltraComboEditor ultraComboEditor2 = chartLayerAxisYEditor;
					int num = (chartLayerAxisY2Editor.SelectedIndex = -1);
					int selectedIndex = (ultraComboEditor2.SelectedIndex = num);
					ultraComboEditor.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < chartLayerSeriesListBox.L.Items.Count; i++)
				{
					bool value = chartLayerSeriesListBox.L.Items[i] is ISeries obj && chartLayerAppearance.Series.Contains(obj);
					chartLayerSeriesListBox.L.SetSelected(i, value);
				}
			}
			noUpdateChart = flag;
		}

		private void SyncChartLayerChartType()
		{
			if (chartLayersListBox.L.SelectedItem is ChartLayerAppearance { ChartType: var chartType })
			{
				switch (chartType)
				{
				case ChartType.CandleChart:
				case ChartType.ParetoChart:
				{
					UltraComboEditor ultraComboEditor7 = chartLayerAxisXEditor;
					UltraComboEditor ultraComboEditor8 = chartLayerAxisYEditor;
					UltraComboEditor ultraComboEditor9 = chartLayerAxisY2Editor;
					UltraLabel ultraLabel4 = chartLayerAxisXLabel;
					UltraLabel ultraLabel5 = chartLayerAxisYLabel;
					bool flag16 = (((Control)(object)chartLayerAxisY2Label).Visible = true);
					bool flag18 = (((Control)(object)ultraLabel5).Visible = flag16);
					bool flag20 = (((Control)(object)ultraLabel4).Visible = flag18);
					bool flag22 = (((Control)(object)ultraComboEditor9).Visible = flag20);
					bool visible4 = (((Control)(object)ultraComboEditor8).Visible = flag22);
					((Control)(object)ultraComboEditor7).Visible = visible4;
					break;
				}
				case ChartType.PieChart:
				case ChartType.RadarChart:
				case ChartType.DoughnutChart:
				{
					UltraComboEditor ultraComboEditor4 = chartLayerAxisXEditor;
					UltraComboEditor ultraComboEditor5 = chartLayerAxisYEditor;
					UltraComboEditor ultraComboEditor6 = chartLayerAxisY2Editor;
					UltraLabel ultraLabel2 = chartLayerAxisXLabel;
					UltraLabel ultraLabel3 = chartLayerAxisYLabel;
					bool flag7 = (((Control)(object)chartLayerAxisY2Label).Visible = false);
					bool flag9 = (((Control)(object)ultraLabel3).Visible = flag7);
					bool flag11 = (((Control)(object)ultraLabel2).Visible = flag9);
					bool flag13 = (((Control)(object)ultraComboEditor6).Visible = flag11);
					bool visible3 = (((Control)(object)ultraComboEditor5).Visible = flag13);
					((Control)(object)ultraComboEditor4).Visible = visible3;
					break;
				}
				default:
				{
					UltraComboEditor ultraComboEditor = chartLayerAxisXEditor;
					UltraComboEditor ultraComboEditor2 = chartLayerAxisYEditor;
					UltraLabel ultraLabel = chartLayerAxisXLabel;
					bool flag = (((Control)(object)chartLayerAxisYLabel).Visible = true);
					bool flag3 = (((Control)(object)ultraLabel).Visible = flag);
					bool visible = (((Control)(object)ultraComboEditor2).Visible = flag3);
					((Control)(object)ultraComboEditor).Visible = visible;
					UltraComboEditor ultraComboEditor3 = chartLayerAxisY2Editor;
					bool visible2 = (((Control)(object)chartLayerAxisY2Label).Visible = false);
					((Control)(object)ultraComboEditor3).Visible = visible2;
					break;
				}
				}
			}
		}

		private void SyncSeriesControls()
		{
			bool flag = noUpdateChart;
			noUpdateChart = true;
			if (seriesListBox.L.SelectedItem is ISeries series)
			{
				ultraGrid1.DataSource = series.GetPoints();
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands[0].Columns["Empty"];
				bool hidden = (ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands[0].Columns["PE"].Hidden = true);
				ultraGridColumn.Hidden = hidden;
				if (ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands.Count == 2)
				{
					if (ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands[1].Columns.Exists("ID"))
					{
						ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands[1].Columns["ID"].Hidden = true;
					}
					if (ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands[1].Columns.Exists("LinkToID"))
					{
						ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands[1].Columns["LinkToID"].Hidden = true;
					}
					if (ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands[1].Columns.Exists("Length"))
					{
						ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands[1].Columns["Length"].Hidden = true;
					}
					if (ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands[1].Columns.Exists("Start"))
					{
						ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands[1].Columns["Start"].Header.VisiblePosition = 0;
					}
					if (ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands[1].Columns.Exists("End"))
					{
						ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands[1].Columns["End"].Header.VisiblePosition = 1;
					}
					if (ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands[1].Columns.Exists("Owner"))
					{
						ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands[1].Columns["Owner"].Header.VisiblePosition = 2;
					}
					if (ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands[1].Columns.Exists("PercentComplete"))
					{
						ultraGrid1.DisplayLayout.Bands[1].Columns["PercentComplete"].Header.VisiblePosition = 3;
					}
				}
				Util.PopulateItems(seriesPEsListBox.L.Items, series.PEs);
				((Control)(object)seriesLabelEditor).Text = series.Label;
				ultraGrid1.DataBind();
			}
			noUpdateChart = flag;
		}

		private void SyncLegendControls()
		{
			bool flag = noUpdateChart;
			noUpdateChart = true;
			if (legendsListbox.L.SelectedItem is CompositeLegend compositeLegend)
			{
				legendBoundsEditor.BoundsMeasureType = compositeLegend.BoundsMeasureType;
				legendBoundsEditor.SelectedBounds = compositeLegend.Bounds;
				legendPEPropertyGrid.SelectedObject = compositeLegend.PE;
				Attribute[] array = new Attribute[legendPEPropertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes.Count + 1];
				legendPEPropertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes.CopyTo(array, 0);
				array[array.Length - 1] = new WizardBrowsableAttribute(browsable: true);
				legendPEPropertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes = new AttributeCollection(array);
				Util.PopulateItems(legendChartLayersListBox.L.Items, ultraChart1.CompositeChart.ChartLayers);
				for (int i = 0; i < legendChartLayersListBox.L.Items.Count; i++)
				{
					bool value = legendChartLayersListBox.L.Items[i] is ChartLayerAppearance layer && compositeLegend.ChartLayers.Contains(layer);
					legendChartLayersListBox.L.SetSelected(i, value);
				}
			}
			noUpdateChart = flag;
		}

		private void SyncChartArea()
		{
			if (!noUpdateChart && chartAreasListBox.L.SelectedItem is ChartArea chartArea)
			{
				chartArea.BoundsMeasureType = chartAreaBoundsEditor.BoundsMeasureType;
				chartArea.Bounds = chartAreaBoundsEditor.SelectedBounds;
			}
			ultraChart1.InvalidateLayers();
		}

		private void SyncAxis()
		{
			if (!noUpdateChart && axesListBox.L.SelectedItem is AxisItem axisItem)
			{
				axisItem.OrientationType = (AxisNumber)axisOrientationEditor.SelectedItem.DataValue;
				axisItem.Extent = (int)axisExtentEditor.Value;
				axisItem.DataType = (AxisDataType)axisDataTypeEditor.SelectedItem.DataValue;
				axisItem.SetLabelAxisType = (SetLabelAxisType)axisSetLabelAxisTypeEditor.SelectedItem.DataValue;
				if (axisSmartTicksEditor.Checked)
				{
					axisItem.TickmarkStyle = AxisTickStyle.Smart;
				}
				else if (axisItem.TickmarkStyle == AxisTickStyle.Smart)
				{
					axisItem.TickmarkStyle = AxisTickStyle.Percentage;
				}
				ultraChart1.InvalidateLayers();
			}
		}

		private void SyncSeries()
		{
			if (!noUpdateChart && seriesListBox.L.SelectedItem is ISeries series)
			{
				series.Label = ((Control)(object)seriesLabelEditor).Text;
				ultraChart1.InvalidateLayers();
			}
		}

		private void SyncChartLayer()
		{
			if (!noUpdateChart && chartLayersListBox.L.SelectedItem is ChartLayerAppearance chartLayerAppearance)
			{
				if (chartLayerChartAreaEditor.SelectedItem != null)
				{
					chartLayerAppearance.ChartArea = chartLayerChartAreaEditor.SelectedItem.DataValue as ChartArea;
				}
				if (chartLayerAxisXEditor.SelectedItem != null)
				{
					chartLayerAppearance.AxisX = chartLayerAxisXEditor.SelectedItem.DataValue as AxisItem;
				}
				if (chartLayerAxisYEditor.SelectedItem != null)
				{
					chartLayerAppearance.AxisY = chartLayerAxisYEditor.SelectedItem.DataValue as AxisItem;
				}
				if (chartLayerAxisY2Editor.SelectedItem != null)
				{
					chartLayerAppearance.AxisY2 = chartLayerAxisY2Editor.SelectedItem.DataValue as AxisItem;
				}
				if (chartLayerChartTypeEditor.SelectedItem != null)
				{
					chartLayerAppearance.ChartType = (ChartType)chartLayerChartTypeEditor.SelectedItem.DataValue;
				}
				ultraChart1.InvalidateLayers();
			}
		}

		private void RebuildLegendsListbox(int selectedIndex)
		{
			legendsListbox.Items.Clear();
			foreach (CompositeLegend item in (IEnumerable)ultraChart1.CompositeChart.Legends)
			{
				legendsListbox.Items.Add(item);
			}
			legendsListbox.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
		}

		private void SyncLegend()
		{
			if (!noUpdateChart && legendsListbox.L.SelectedItem is CompositeLegend compositeLegend)
			{
				compositeLegend.Bounds = legendBoundsEditor.SelectedBounds;
				compositeLegend.BoundsMeasureType = legendBoundsEditor.BoundsMeasureType;
				RebuildLegendsListbox(legendsListbox.L.SelectedIndex);
				ultraChart1.InvalidateLayers();
			}
		}

		private void chartAreaRectEditors_ValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SyncChartArea();
		}

		private void axisEditors_ValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SyncAxis();
			if (axesListBox.L.SelectedItem is AxisItem axisItem)
			{
				UltraComboEditor ultraComboEditor = axisSetLabelAxisTypeEditor;
				bool visible = (((Control)(object)axisSetLabelAxisTypeLabel).Visible = axisItem.DataType == AxisDataType.String);
				((Control)(object)ultraComboEditor).Visible = visible;
			}
		}

		private void seriesEditors_ValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SyncSeries();
		}

		private void chartLayerEditors_ValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender == chartLayerChartAreaEditor && chartLayerChartAreaEditor.SelectedItem.DataValue is ChartArea chartArea)
			{
				bool flag = noUpdateChart;
				noUpdateChart = true;
				Util.PopulateItems((IList)chartLayerAxisXEditor.Items, chartArea.Axes);
				Util.PopulateItems((IList)chartLayerAxisYEditor.Items, chartArea.Axes);
				Util.PopulateItems((IList)chartLayerAxisY2Editor.Items, chartArea.Axes);
				if (chartLayersListBox.L.SelectedItem is ChartLayerAppearance chartLayerAppearance)
				{
					if (chartLayerAppearance.AxisXKey != null && chartLayerAppearance.AxisXKey.Length > 0)
					{
						chartLayerAxisXEditor.SelectedIndex = chartLayerAxisXEditor.FindString(chartLayerAppearance.AxisXKey);
					}
					if (chartLayerAppearance.AxisYKey != null && chartLayerAppearance.AxisYKey.Length > 0)
					{
						chartLayerAxisYEditor.SelectedIndex = chartLayerAxisYEditor.FindString(chartLayerAppearance.AxisYKey);
					}
					if (chartLayerAppearance.AxisY2Key != null && chartLayerAppearance.AxisY2Key.Length > 0)
					{
						chartLayerAxisY2Editor.SelectedIndex = chartLayerAxisY2Editor.FindString(chartLayerAppearance.AxisY2Key);
					}
				}
				noUpdateChart = flag;
			}
			SyncChartLayer();
			if (chartLayersListBox.L.SelectedItem is ChartLayerAppearance chartLayerAppearance2)
			{
				UltraTab ultraTab = chartLayerTabControl.Tabs[1];
				if (chartLayerAppearance2.AxesValidForLayer(out var errorMessage))
				{
					ultraTab.Appearance.ForeColor = Color.Empty;
				}
				else
				{
					ultraTab.Appearance.ForeColor = Color.Red;
				}
				((Control)(object)chartLayerAxisInformationLabel).Text = errorMessage;
				if (sender == chartLayerChartTypeEditor)
				{
					chartLayerChartTypeAppearancePropertyGrid.SelectedObject = chartLayerAppearance2.ChartTypeAppearance;
					SyncChartLayerChartType();
					bool flag2 = noUpdateChart;
					noUpdateChart = true;
					Util.RefreshListBox(chartLayersListBox.L);
					noUpdateChart = flag2;
				}
			}
		}

		private void listBoxes_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender == chartAreasListBox.L)
			{
				if (chartAreasListBox.L.SelectedItem is ChartArea chartArea)
				{
					BlinkPE(chartArea.PE);
				}
				SyncChartAreaControls();
			}
			else if (sender == axesListBox.L)
			{
				SyncAxisControls();
			}
			else if (sender == chartLayersListBox.L)
			{
				SyncChartLayerControls();
			}
			else if (sender == seriesListBox.L)
			{
				SyncSeriesControls();
			}
			else if (sender == legendsListbox.L)
			{
				_ = legendsListbox.L.SelectedItem;
				SyncLegendControls();
			}
			else if (sender == seriesPEsListBox.L)
			{
				seriesPEPropertyGrid.SelectedObject = seriesPEsListBox.L.SelectedItem;
			}
			else if (sender == chartLayerSeriesListBox.L)
			{
				if (chartLayersListBox.L.SelectedItem is ChartLayerAppearance chartLayerAppearance && !noUpdateChart)
				{
					chartLayerAppearance.Series.Clear();
					for (int i = 0; i < chartLayerSeriesListBox.L.SelectedItems.Count; i++)
					{
						chartLayerAppearance.Series.Add(chartLayerSeriesListBox.L.SelectedItems[i] as ISeries);
					}
					ultraChart1.InvalidateLayers();
				}
			}
			else if (sender == legendChartLayersListBox.L && legendsListbox.L.SelectedItem is CompositeLegend compositeLegend && !noUpdateChart)
			{
				compositeLegend.ChartLayers.Clear();
				for (int j = 0; j < legendChartLayersListBox.L.SelectedItems.Count; j++)
				{
					compositeLegend.ChartLayers.Add(legendChartLayersListBox.L.SelectedItems[j] as ChartLayerAppearance);
				}
				ultraChart1.InvalidateLayers();
			}
		}

		private void OnChartAreasCollectionChanged()

			noUpdateChart = true;
			Util.PopulateItems((IList)chartLayerChartAreaEditor.Items, ultraChart1.CompositeChart.ChartAreas);

			{
				chartLayerChartAreaEditor.SelectedIndex = chartLayerChartAreaEditor.FindString(chartLayerAppearance.ChartArea.Key);
			}
			noUpdateChart = flag;
		}

		{
			bool flag = noUpdateChart;

			Util.PopulateItems(chartLayerSeriesListBox.L.Items, ultraChart1.CompositeChart.Series);
			if (chartLayersListBox.L.SelectedItem is ChartLayerAppearance chartLayerAppearance)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < ultraChart1.CompositeChart.Series.Count; i++)
				{
					ISeries obj = ultraChart1.CompositeChart.Series[i];

					chartLayerSeriesListBox.L.SetSelected(i, value);
				}
			}
			noUpdateChart = flag;
		}

		private void OnLegendsCollectionChanged()
