		}

		private void addButtons_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0105: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (sender == addChartAreaButton)
			{
				ChartArea chartArea = new ChartArea(ultraChart1);
				ultraChart1.CompositeChart.ChartAreas.Add(chartArea);
				chartAreasListBox.L.SelectedIndex = chartAreasListBox.L.Items.Add(chartArea);
				OnChartAreasCollectionChanged();
			}
			else if (sender == addAxisButton)
			{
				((PopupToolBase)(PopupMenuTool)((ToolsCollectionBase)ultraToolbarsManager1.Tools)["addAxisPopupMenuTool"]).ShowPopup();
			}
			else if (sender == addChartLayerButton)
			{
				ChartLayerAppearance chartLayerAppearance = new ChartLayerAppearance(ultraChart1);
				ultraChart1.CompositeChart.ChartLayers.Add(chartLayerAppearance);
				chartLayersListBox.L.SelectedIndex = chartLayersListBox.L.Items.Add(chartLayerAppearance);
				OnChartLayersCollectionChanged();
			}
			else if (sender == addSeriesButton)
			{
				((PopupToolBase)(PopupMenuTool)((ToolsCollectionBase)ultraToolbarsManager1.Tools)["addSeriesPopupMenuTool"]).ShowPopup();
			}
			else if (sender == addLegendButton)
			{
				CompositeLegend compositeLegend = new CompositeLegend(ultraChart1);
				ultraChart1.CompositeChart.Legends.Add(compositeLegend);
				legendsListbox.L.SelectedIndex = legendsListbox.L.Items.Add(compositeLegend);
				OnLegendsCollectionChanged();
			}
			else if (sender == seriesAddPEButton && seriesListBox.L.SelectedItem is ISeries series)
			{
				PaintElement paintElement = new PaintElement();
				series.PEs.Add(paintElement);
				seriesPEsListBox.L.SelectedIndex = seriesPEsListBox.L.Items.Add(paintElement);
			}
			if (this.Updated != null)
			{
				this.Updated(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void removeButtons_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender == removeChartAreaButton)
			{
				if (chartAreasListBox.L.SelectedItem is ChartArea chartArea)
				{
					ultraChart1.CompositeChart.ChartAreas.Remove(chartArea);
					chartAreasListBox.L.Items.Remove(chartArea);
					OnChartAreasCollectionChanged();
				}
			}
			else if (sender == removeAxisButton)
			{
				ChartArea chartArea2 = chartAreasListBox.L.SelectedItem as ChartArea;
				AxisItem axisItem = axesListBox.L.SelectedItem as AxisItem;
				if (chartArea2 != null && axisItem != null)
				{
					chartArea2.Axes.Remove(axisItem);
					axesListBox.L.Items.Remove(axisItem);
					OnAxesCollectionChanged();
				}
			}
			else if (sender == removeChartLayerButton)
			{
				if (chartLayersListBox.L.SelectedItem is ChartLayerAppearance chartLayerAppearance)
				{
					ultraChart1.CompositeChart.ChartLayers.Remove(chartLayerAppearance);
					chartLayersListBox.L.Items.Remove(chartLayerAppearance);
					OnChartLayersCollectionChanged();
				}
			}
			else if (sender == removeSeriesButton)
			{
				if (seriesListBox.L.SelectedItem is ISeries series)
				{
					ultraChart1.CompositeChart.Series.Remove(series);
					seriesListBox.L.Items.Remove(series);
					ultraGrid1.DataSource = null;
					ultraGrid1.DataBind();
					OnSeriesCollectionChanged();
				}
			}
			else if (sender == removeLegendButton)
			{
				if (legendsListbox.L.SelectedItem is CompositeLegend compositeLegend)
				{
					ultraChart1.CompositeChart.Legends.Remove(compositeLegend);
					legendsListbox.L.Items.Remove(compositeLegend);
					OnLegendsCollectionChanged();
				}
			}
			else if (sender == seriesRemovePEButton && seriesListBox.L.SelectedItem is ISeries series2 && seriesPEsListBox.L.SelectedItem is PaintElement value)
			{
				series2.PEs.Remove(value);
				seriesPEsListBox.L.Items.Remove(value);
			}
			if (this.Updated != null)
			{
				this.Updated(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void ultraToolbarsManager1_ToolClick(object sender, ToolClickEventArgs e)
		{
			SeriesBase seriesBase = null;
			AxisItem axisItem = null;
			switch (((KeyedSubObjectBase)(object)((ToolEventArgs)e).Tool).Key)
			{
			case "addNumericSeriesButtonTool":
				seriesBase = new NumericSeries(ultraChart1);
				break;
			case "addXYSeriesButtonTool":
				seriesBase = new XYSeries(ultraChart1);
				break;
			case "addXYZSeriesButtonTool":
				seriesBase = new XYZSeries(ultraChart1);
				break;
			case "addNumericTimeSeriesButtonTool":
				seriesBase = new NumericTimeSeries(ultraChart1);
				break;
			case "addCandleSeriesButtonTool":
				seriesBase = new CandleSeries(ultraChart1);
				break;
			case "addGanttSeriesButtonTool":
				seriesBase = new GanttSeries(ultraChart1);
				break;
			case "addBoxSetSeriesButtonTool":
				seriesBase = new BoxSetSeries(ultraChart1);
				break;
			case "addXAxisButtonTool":
				axisItem = new AxisItem(ultraChart1, AxisNumber.X_Axis);
				break;
			case "addYAxisButtonTool":
				axisItem = new AxisItem(ultraChart1, AxisNumber.Y_Axis);
				break;
			case "addX2AxisButtonTool":
				axisItem = new AxisItem(ultraChart1, AxisNumber.X2_Axis);
				break;
			case "addY2AxisButtonTool":
				axisItem = new AxisItem(ultraChart1, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis);
				break;
			}
			if (axisItem != null && chartAreasListBox.L.SelectedItem is ChartArea chartArea)
			{
				chartArea.Axes.Add(axisItem);
				axesListBox.L.SelectedIndex = axesListBox.L.Items.Add(axisItem);
				OnAxesCollectionChanged();
			}
			if (seriesBase != null)
			{
				ultraChart1.CompositeChart.Series.Add(seriesBase);
				seriesListBox.L.SelectedIndex = seriesListBox.L.Items.Add(seriesBase);
				OnSeriesCollectionChanged();
			}
			if (this.Updated != null)
			{
				this.Updated(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void legendBoundsEditor_ValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SyncLegend();
		}

		internal bool MoveNext()
		{
			if (ultraTabControl1.SelectedTab.Index == ultraTabControl1.Tabs.Count - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ultraTabControl1.SelectedTab = ultraTabControl1.Tabs[ultraTabControl1.SelectedTab.Index + 1];
			return true;
		}

		internal bool MovePrevious()
		{
			if (ultraTabControl1.SelectedTab.Index == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ultraTabControl1.SelectedTab = ultraTabControl1.Tabs[ultraTabControl1.SelectedTab.Index - 1];
			return true;
		}

		private void propertyGrids_PropertyValueChanged(object s, PropertyValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ultraChart1.InvalidateLayers();
		}

		private void ultraGrid1_AfterRowUpdate(object sender, RowEventArgs e)
		{
			ultraChart1.InvalidateLayers();
		}

		private void ultraGrid1_AfterRowInsert(object sender, RowEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Row != null && e.Row.IsAddRow)
			{
				e.Row.Update();
			}
		}

		private void editors_Enter(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is UltraNumericEditor ultraNumericEditor)
			{
				ultraNumericEditor.SelectAll();
			}
		}

		private void editors_MouseWheel(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is UltraNumericEditor ultraNumericEditor && ultraNumericEditor.Value is int)
			{
				if (e.Delta > 0)
				{
					ultraNumericEditor.Value = (int)ultraNumericEditor.Value + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					ultraNumericEditor.Value = Math.Max(0, (int)ultraNumericEditor.Value - 1);
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Editor
{
	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	public class ChartEditorControlBase : UserControl
	{
		private object component;

		private PropertyDescriptor property;

		private ChartUIEditorBase PropEditor;

		private ITypeDescriptorContext context;

		private object val;

		public object Component
		{
			get
			{
				return component;
			}
			set
			{
				component = value;
			}
		}

		public PropertyDescriptor Property
		{
			get
			{
				return property;
			}
			set
			{
				property = value;
			}
		}

		public ITypeDescriptorContext Context
		{
			get
			{
				return context;
			}
			set
			{
				context = value;
			}
		}

		public ChartUIEditorBase Editor
		{
			get
			{
				return PropEditor;
			}
			set
			{
				PropEditor = value;
			}
		}

		public ChartEditorControlBase()
		{
		}

		public ChartEditorControlBase(ChartUIEditorBase editor)
		{
			PropEditor = editor;
		}

		public void Apply()
		{
			if (component is IChartComponent)
			{
				((IChartComponent)component).Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
			if (Context != null)
			{
				Context.OnComponentChanged();
			}
		}

		public void Cancel()
		{
			if (Editor != null)
			{
				Editor.edSvc.CloseDropDown();
			}
		}

		public void Ok()
		{
			if (Context != null)
			{
				Context.OnComponentChanged();
			}
			if (Editor != null)
			{
				Editor.edSvc.CloseDropDown();
				if (component is IChartComponent)
				{
					((IChartComponent)component).Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Preview()
		{
			if (Context != null)
			{
				Context.OnComponentChanged();
			}
			if (component is IChartComponent)
			{
				((IChartComponent)component).Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
		}

		public virtual void SetValue(object val)
		{
			this.val = val;
		}

		public virtual object GetValue()
		{
			return val;
		}
	}

		{
			_MainTabControl = new UltraTabControl();
			base.Controls.Add((Control)(object)_MainTabControl);
			((Control)(object)_MainTabControl).Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
		}

		public ChartTypeCtrl(ChartUIEditorBase ed)
			: base(ed)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			try
			{
				InitTabControl();
			}
			catch (LicenseException)
			{
			}
			_TooltipManager = new UltraToolTipManager();
			TooltipManager.DisplayStyle = (ToolTipDisplayStyle)3;
			TooltipManager.InitialDelay = 10;
			base.Width = CONTROL_WIDTH;
		}

		private void pictureBoxes_MouseDown(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			PictureBox pictureBox = sender as PictureBox;
			ctype = GetChartType(pictureBox.Name);
			done();
		}

		private void pictureBoxes_MouseEnter(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			PictureBox pictureBox = sender as PictureBox;
			ChartType chartType = GetChartType(pictureBox.Name);
			int skinIndex = ((ChartIconInfo)ChartIconInfoTable[chartType]).SkinIndex;
			pictureBox.Image = ChartImagesSkin.Elements[skinIndex + 56].Image;
		}

		private void pictureBoxes_MouseLeave(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			PictureBox pictureBox = sender as PictureBox;
			ChartType chartType = GetChartType(pictureBox.Name);
			int skinIndex = ((ChartIconInfo)ChartIconInfoTable[chartType]).SkinIndex;
			if (ctype == chartType)
			{
				pictureBox.Image = ChartImagesSkin.Elements[skinIndex + 112].Image;
			}
			else
			{
				pictureBox.Image = ChartImagesSkin.Elements[skinIndex].Image;
			}
		}

		private string GetChartTypeString(string controlName)
		{
			if (controlName != null)
			{
				string[] array = controlName.Split('_');
				if (array != null && array.Length == 2)
				{
					return array[1];
				}
			}
			return "ColumnChart";
		}

		private ChartType GetChartType(string controlName)
		{
			return (ChartType)Enum.Parse(typeof(ChartType), GetChartTypeString(controlName));
		}

		private PictureBox AddPictureBoxToTab(ChartIconInfo iconInfo, UltraTab tab, ChartType currentChartType)
		{
			//IL_00e4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ee: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PictureBox pictureBox = new PictureBox();
			pictureBox.Name = tab.Key.ToLower() + "_" + currentChartType;
			pictureBox.Size = new Size(48, 48);
			pictureBox.SizeMode = PictureBoxSizeMode.StretchImage;
			if (currentChartType == ctype)
			{
				pictureBox.Image = ChartImagesSkin.Elements[iconInfo.SkinIndex + 112].Image;
			}
			else
			{
				pictureBox.Image = ChartImagesSkin.Elements[iconInfo.SkinIndex].Image;
			}
			pictureBox.MouseDown += pictureBoxes_MouseDown;
			pictureBox.MouseEnter += pictureBoxes_MouseEnter;
			pictureBox.MouseLeave += pictureBoxes_MouseLeave;
			TooltipManager.SetUltraToolTip((Control)pictureBox, new UltraToolTipInfo(SR.GetString("SR_" + currentChartType), (ToolTipImage)2, (string)null, (DefaultableBoolean)1));
			((Control)(object)tab.TabPage).Controls.Add(pictureBox);
			return pictureBox;
		}

		private void done()
		{
			Ok();
			OnClick(new EventArgs());
		}

		public void ResetTabs()
		{
			if (_MainTabControl == null)
			{
				InitTabControl();
			}
			_MainTabControl.Tabs.Clear();
			((ScrollableControl)(object)_MainTabControl.Tabs.Add("All", CATEGORY_ALL).TabPage).AutoScroll = true;
			((ScrollableControl)(object)_MainTabControl.Tabs.Add("Composite", CATEGORY_COMPOSITE).TabPage).AutoScroll = true;
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
			hashtable.Add(_MainTabControl.Tabs["All"], new Point(0, 0));
			hashtable.Add(_MainTabControl.Tabs["Composite"], new Point(0, 0));
			string[] categories = Categories;
			foreach (string key in categories)
			{
				UltraTab key2 = _MainTabControl.Tabs.Add(key, key);
				hashtable.Add(key2, new Point(0, 0));
			}
			ChartType[] array = (ChartType[])Enum.GetValues(typeof(ChartType));
			ChartType[] array2 = array;
			foreach (ChartType chartType in array2)
			{
				if (!(ChartIconInfoTable[chartType] is ChartIconInfo))
				{
					continue;
				}
				ChartIconInfo iconInfo = (ChartIconInfo)ChartIconInfoTable[chartType];
				if (!iconInfo.Visible)
				{
					continue;
				}
				UltraTab ultraTab = _MainTabControl.Tabs["All"];
				PictureBox pictureBox = AddPictureBoxToTab(iconInfo, ultraTab, chartType);
				Point point = (pictureBox.Location = (Point)hashtable[ultraTab]);
				Point point3 = point;
				if (point3.X + 96 >= base.Width)
				{
					point3.X = 0;
					point3.Y += 48;
				}
				else
				{
					point3.X += 48;
				}
				hashtable[ultraTab] = point3;
				base.Height = Math.Max(base.Size.Height, point3.Y + 48 + 28);
				base.Height = Math.Min(290, base.Height);
				string[] categories2 = iconInfo.Categories;
				foreach (string key3 in categories2)
				{
					UltraTab ultraTab2 = _MainTabControl.Tabs[key3];
					pictureBox = AddPictureBoxToTab(iconInfo, ultraTab2, chartType);
					Point point4 = (pictureBox.Location = (Point)hashtable[ultraTab2]);
					point3 = point4;
					if (point3.X + 96 >= base.Width)
					{
						point3.X = 0;
						point3.Y += 48;
					}
					else
					{
						point3.X += 48;
					}
					hashtable[ultraTab2] = point3;
				}
				object[] customAttributes = typeof(ChartType).GetField(chartType.ToString()).GetCustomAttributes(typeof(CompositeChartBrowsableAttribute), inherit: true);
				if (customAttributes.Length == 0 || (customAttributes[0] is CompositeChartBrowsableAttribute && ((CompositeChartBrowsableAttribute)customAttributes[0]).Browsable))
				{
					UltraTab ultraTab3 = _MainTabControl.Tabs["Composite"];
					pictureBox = AddPictureBoxToTab(iconInfo, ultraTab3, chartType);
					Point point6 = (pictureBox.Location = (Point)hashtable[ultraTab3]);
					point3 = point6;
					if (point3.X + 96 >= base.Width)
					{
						point3.X = 0;
						point3.Y += 48;
					}
					else
					{
						point3.X += 48;
					}
					hashtable[ultraTab3] = point3;
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetComposite(bool composite)
		{
			if (_MainTabControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < _MainTabControl.Tabs.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTab ultraTab = _MainTabControl.Tabs[i];
				if (composite != (ultraTab.Key == "Composite"))
				{
					_MainTabControl.Tabs.RemoveAt(i);
					i--;
				}
			}
			_MainTabControl.SelectedTab = _MainTabControl.Tabs[0];
		}

		public override void SetValue(object val)
		{
			ctype = (ChartType)val;
		}

		public override object GetValue()
		{
			return ctype;
		}
	}
	public class DefaultPreset
	{
		private const string DefaultPresetResourceName = "Infragistics.UltraChart.Design.DefaultPresets.UltraChartDefaultPreset.xml";

		public static void LoadDefaultPreset(Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart chart)
		{
			if (chart == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ChartWizard.Settings == null)
			{
				string filename = "ChartDesignerSettings";
				ChartWizard.Settings = DesignerSettings.Load(filename);
			}
			if (ChartWizard.Settings != null)
			{
				if (!ChartWizard.Settings.UseDefaultPreset)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (ChartWizard.Settings.DefaultPresetPath != null && ChartWizard.Settings.DefaultPresetPath.Length > 0 && File.Exists(ChartWizard.Settings.DefaultPresetPath))
				{
					try
					{
						chart.LoadPreset(ChartWizard.Settings.DefaultPresetPath, reset: false);
						return;
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
			}
			Stream manifestResourceStream = typeof(DefaultPreset).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("Infragistics.UltraChart.Design.DefaultPresets.UltraChartDefaultPreset.xml");
			chart.LoadPreset(manifestResourceStream, reset: false);
		}
	}

	public abstract class ChartCollectionEditorBase : UITypeEditor
	{
		protected abstract string CollectionPropertyName { get; }

		protected abstract Type CollectionEditorFormType { get; }

		[ComVisible(false)]
		[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
		{
			if (context != null && context.Instance != null && provider != null)
			{
				PropertyInfo property = context.Instance.GetType().GetProperty(CollectionPropertyName);
				if (property != null && property.GetValue(context.Instance, null) is IChartCollection chartCollection)
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = CollectionEditorFormType.GetConstructor(new Type[2]
					{
						typeof(IChartCollection),
						typeof(PropertyDescriptor)
					});
					if (constructor != null)
					{
						if (chartCollection.ChartComponent == null && context.Instance is IProvideChartComponent)
						{
							IChartComponent chartComponent = ((IProvideChartComponent)context.Instance).ChartComponent;
							if (chartComponent != null)
							{
								chartCollection.ChartComponent = chartComponent;
							}
						}
						if (constructor.Invoke(new object[2] { chartCollection, context.PropertyDescriptor }) is ChartCollectionEditorBaseForm chartCollectionEditorBaseForm)
						{
							chartCollectionEditorBaseForm.ShowDialog();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		[ComVisible(false)]
		[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
		public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			if (context != null && context.Instance != null)
			{
				return UITypeEditorEditStyle.Modal;
			}
			return base.GetEditStyle(context);
		}

		[ComVisible(false)]
		[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
		public override bool GetPaintValueSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal static void ForceSerialization(GridItem gridItemForVisibleProperty)
		{
			Type type = gridItemForVisibleProperty.GetType();
			PropertyInfo property = type.GetProperty("GridEntryHost", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.GetProperty);
			if (!(property != null) || gridItemForVisibleProperty == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object value = property.GetValue(gridItemForVisibleProperty, new object[0]);
			if (value != null)
			{
				Type type2 = value.GetType();
				MethodInfo method = type2.GetMethod("CommitValue", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.InvokeMethod, null, new Type[2]
				{
					type,
					typeof(object)
				}, null);
				if (method != null)
				{
					bool flag = (bool)gridItemForVisibleProperty.Value;
					method.Invoke(value, new object[2]
					{
						gridItemForVisibleProperty,
						!flag
					});
					method.Invoke(value, new object[2] { gridItemForVisibleProperty, flag });
				}
			}
		}
	}

		private void propertyGridContextMenu_Popup(object sender, BeforeToolDropdownEventArgs e)
		{
			PropertyReset = null;
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = propertyGrid.SelectedGridItem.PropertyDescriptor;
			if (propertyDescriptor != null)
			{
				if (propertyDescriptor.Attributes != null && propertyDescriptor.Attributes[typeof(DefaultValueAttribute)] != null)
				{
					if (propertyDescriptor.Attributes[typeof(DefaultValueAttribute)] is DefaultValueAttribute defaultValueAttribute)
					{
						PropertyReset = defaultValueAttribute.Value;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Type type = ((propertyGrid == null || propertyGrid.SelectedGridItem == null || propertyGrid.SelectedGridItem.Parent == null || propertyGrid.SelectedGridItem.Parent.PropertyDescriptor == null) ? propertyGrid.SelectedObject.GetType() : propertyGrid.SelectedGridItem.Parent.PropertyDescriptor.PropertyType);
					MethodInfo method = type.GetMethod("Reset" + propertyDescriptor.Name);
					if (method != null)
					{
						PropertyReset = method;
					}
				}
			}
			((ToolsCollectionBase)propertyGridContextMenu.Tools)["contextMenuReset"].SharedProps.Enabled = PropertyReset != null;
		}

		private void propertyGrid_PropertyValueChanged(object s, PropertyValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ChangedItem.Value is LocationType)
			{
				UpdatePropertyGridBrowsableAttributes((LocationType)e.ChangedItem.Value);
			}
			else if (e.ChangedItem.Value is PaintElementType)
			{
				UpdatePropertyGridBrowsableAttributes((PaintElementType)e.ChangedItem.Value);
			}
			else if (e.ChangedItem.Value is LocationOffsetMode)
			{
				UpdatePropertyGridBrowsableAttributes((LocationOffsetMode)e.ChangedItem.Value);
			}
			RefreshListBox();
			RefreshChart();
		}

		private void propertyGrid_SelectedObjectsChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (propertyGrid.SelectedObject is Annotation)
			{
				Annotation annotation = (Annotation)propertyGrid.SelectedObject;
				if (annotation.Location != null)
				{
					LocationType locationType = annotation.Location.Type;
					if (annotation is OffsetableAnnotation)
					{
						locationType |= ((OffsetableAnnotation)annotation).Offset.Type;
					}
					UpdatePropertyGridBrowsableAttributes(locationType);
				}
				if (annotation is IProvidePaintElement { PE: not null } providePaintElement)
				{
					UpdatePropertyGridBrowsableAttributes(providePaintElement.PE.ElementType);
				}
				if (annotation is OffsetableAnnotation offsetableAnnotation)
				{
					UpdatePropertyGridBrowsableAttributes(offsetableAnnotation.OffsetMode);
				}
			}
			else if (propertyGrid.SelectedObject is PaintElement)
			{
				PaintElement paintElement = (PaintElement)propertyGrid.SelectedObject;
				UpdatePropertyGridBrowsableAttributes(paintElement.ElementType);
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePropertyGridBrowsableAttributes(LocationOffsetMode offsetMode)
		{
			Attribute[] array = new Attribute[propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes.Count];
			propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes.CopyTo(array, 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array[i] is BrowsableForOffsetModeAttribute)
				{
					array[i] = new BrowsableForOffsetModeAttribute(offsetMode);
				}
			}
			propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes = new AttributeCollection(array);
		}

		private void UpdatePropertyGridBrowsableAttributes(LocationType locationType)
		{
			Attribute[] array = new Attribute[propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes.Count];
			propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes.CopyTo(array, 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array[i] is BrowsableForLocationTypeAttribute)
				{
					array[i] = new BrowsableForLocationTypeAttribute(locationType);
				}
			}
			propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes = new AttributeCollection(array);
		}

		private void UpdatePropertyGridBrowsableAttributes(PaintElementType paintElementType)
		{
			Attribute[] array = new Attribute[propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes.Count];
			propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes.CopyTo(array, 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array[i] is BrowsableForPaintElementTypeAttribute)
				{
					array[i] = new BrowsableForPaintElementTypeAttribute(paintElementType);
				}
			}
			propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes = new AttributeCollection(array);
		}

		protected virtual void RefreshChart()
		{
			IComponent component = null;
			if (propertyGrid.Site != null && propertyGrid.Site.DesignMode)
			{
				component = propertyGrid.Site.Component;
			}
			if (Collection.ChartComponent != null)
			{
				Collection.ChartComponent.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
			if (component == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			TypeDescriptor.Refresh(component);
			IComponentChangeService componentChangeService = (IComponentChangeService)propertyGrid.Site.GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService));
			if (Property != null && Property.ComponentType == component.GetType())
			{
				componentChangeService.OnComponentChanged(component, Property, OldCollection, Collection);
				return;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(component).Find("Visible", ignoreCase: false);
			if (propertyDescriptor != null)
			{
				bool flag = (bool)propertyDescriptor.GetValue(component);
				componentChangeService.OnComponentChanged(component, propertyDescriptor, flag, flag);
			}
		}

		private void ChartCollectionEditorBaseForm_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_02a5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02ac: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((Control)(object)okButton).Text = SR.GetString("SR_OK");
			((Control)(object)cancelButton).Text = SR.GetString("SR_Cancel");
			((Control)(object)removeButton).Text = SR.GetString("SR_Remove");
			((Control)(object)addButton).Text = SR.GetString("SR_Add");
			base.AcceptButton = okButton;
			base.CancelButton = cancelButton;
			if (Collection != null)
			{
				if (Collection.ChartComponent != null && Collection.ChartComponent.Site != null && Collection.ChartComponent.Site.DesignMode)
				{
					propertyGrid.Site = Collection.ChartComponent.Site;
				}
				OldCollection = Collection.Clone() as IChartCollection;
				for (int i = 0; i < Collection.Count; i++)
				{
					listBox.Items.Add(Collection[i]);
				}
				Attribute[] array = new Attribute[propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes.Count + 3];
				propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes.CopyTo(array, 0);
				array[array.Length - 3] = new BrowsableForOffsetModeAttribute(LocationOffsetMode.Automatic | LocationOffsetMode.Manual);
				array[array.Length - 2] = new BrowsableForLocationTypeAttribute(LocationType.RowColumn | LocationType.DataValues | LocationType.Pixels | LocationType.Percentage);
				array[array.Length - 1] = new BrowsableForPaintElementTypeAttribute(PaintElementType.SolidFill | PaintElementType.Image | PaintElementType.Hatch | PaintElementType.Gradient | PaintElementType.CustomBrush | PaintElementType.Texture);
				propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes = new AttributeCollection(array);
				IProvideChartComponent collection = Collection;
				if (collection != null && collection.ChartComponent != null)
				{
					string text = collection.ChartComponent.GetType().ToString();
					if (text.IndexOf("UltraWebChart") >= 0)
					{
						if (propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes != null)
						{
							array = new Attribute[propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes.Count + 1];
							propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes.CopyTo(array, 0);
							array[array.Length - 1] = new WebBrowsableAttribute(browsable: true);
							propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes = new AttributeCollection(array);
						}
					}
					else if (text.IndexOf("UltraWinChart") >= 0 && propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes != null)
					{
						array = new Attribute[propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes.Count + 1];
						propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes.CopyTo(array, 0);
						array[array.Length - 1] = new WinBrowsableAttribute(browsable: true);
						propertyGrid.BrowsableAttributes = new AttributeCollection(array);
					}
				}
			}
			if (ItemTypes != null && ItemTypes.Length > 1 && TypeNames.Length == ItemTypes.Length)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < ItemTypes.Length; j++)
				{
					ButtonTool val = new ButtonTool(TypeNames[j]);
					((ToolPropsBase)((ToolBase)val).SharedProps).Caption = SR.GetString("SR_AddExpressionPrefix") + TypeNames[j] + SR.GetString("SR_AddExpressionSuffix");
					((ToolsCollectionBase)ultraToolbarsManager1.Tools).Add((ToolBase)(object)val);
					addTypeMenu.Tools.AddTool(((KeyedSubObjectBase)(object)val).Key);
				}
			}
			listBox.SelectionMode = SelectionMode.One;
			OnLoaded();
		}

		private void menuItems_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private void upDownButtons_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			int num = ((sender == downButton) ? 1 : (-1));
			int selectedIndex = listBox.SelectedIndex;
			if (selectedIndex + num >= 0 && selectedIndex + num < listBox.Items.Count)
			{
				listBox.Items.RemoveAt(selectedIndex);
				object obj = Collection[selectedIndex];
				Collection.RemoveAt(selectedIndex);
				Collection.Insert(selectedIndex + num, obj);
				listBox.Items.Insert(selectedIndex + num, obj);
				listBox.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex + num;
			}
		}

		private void removeButton_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			int selectedIndex = listBox.SelectedIndex;
			if (selectedIndex >= 0)
			{
				Collection.Remove(listBox.SelectedItem);
				listBox.Items.Remove(listBox.SelectedItem);
				int count = listBox.Items.Count;
				if (selectedIndex < count)
				{
					listBox.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
				}
				else
				{
					listBox.SelectedIndex = count - 1;
				}
				if (count == 0)
				{
					propertyGrid.SelectedObject = null;
				}
				else
				{
					listBox_SelectedIndexChanged(this, null);
				}
				listBox.Refresh();
			}
			RefreshChart();
		}

		protected virtual void OnCancel()
		{
			Collection.Clear();
			foreach (object item in OldCollection)
			{
				Collection.Add(item);
			}
			RefreshChart();
		}

		private void cmdCancel_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnCancel();
		}

		private void okButton_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RefreshChart();
			Close();
		}

		private void listBox_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			propertyGrid.SelectedObject = listBox.SelectedItem;
		}

		private object GetParentOfCurrentProperty(PropertyGrid grid, GridItem current)
		{
			if (current.Parent != null && current.Parent.PropertyDescriptor != null)
			{
				object parentOfCurrentProperty = GetParentOfCurrentProperty(grid, current.Parent);
				if (parentOfCurrentProperty != null)
				{
					PropertyInfo property = parentOfCurrentProperty.GetType().GetProperty(current.PropertyDescriptor.Name);
					if (property != null)
					{
						return property.GetValue(parentOfCurrentProperty, null);
					}
				}
			}
			return grid.SelectedObject;
		}

		protected virtual void RefreshListBox()
		{
			Application.DoEvents();
			object selectedItem = listBox.SelectedItem;
			object[] array = new object[listBox.Items.Count];
			listBox.Items.CopyTo(array, 0);
			listBox.Items.Clear();
			listBox.Items.AddRange(array);
			listBox.SelectedItem = selectedItem;
		}

		private void addButton_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (ItemTypes != null && ItemTypes.Length > 1)
			{
				Point point = PointToScreen(((Control)(object)addButton).Location);
				point.Y += ((Control)(object)addButton).Height;
				((PopupToolBase)addTypeMenu).ShowPopup(point, (Control)(object)addButton);
			}
			else if (ItemTypes != null && ItemTypes.Length > 0)
			{
				AddItem(ItemTypes[0]);
			}
			else
			{
				AddItem(typeof(object));
			}
			RefreshChart();
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded()
		{
		}
	}

		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ultraToolbarsManager1.ToolClick += new ToolClickEventHandler(ToolClick);
		}

		private void ToolClick(object sender, ToolClickEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((ToolEventArgs)e).Tool != null && base.Collection != null)
			{
				AxisItem axisItem = null;
				if (((KeyedSubObjectBase)(object)((ToolEventArgs)e).Tool).Key.IndexOf(TypeNames[0]) != -1)
				{
					axisItem = new AxisItem(base.Collection.ChartComponent, AxisNumber.X_Axis);
				}
				else if (((KeyedSubObjectBase)(object)((ToolEventArgs)e).Tool).Key.IndexOf(TypeNames[1]) >= 0)
				{
					axisItem = new AxisItem(base.Collection.ChartComponent, AxisNumber.Y_Axis);
				}
				if (axisItem != null)
				{
					((AxisCollection)base.Collection).Add(axisItem);
					listBox.SelectedIndex = listBox.Items.Add(axisItem);
				}
			}
			RefreshChart();
		}
	}

	public class AxisPickerEditor : UITypeEditor
	{
		private ListBox _AxesListBox;

		private IWindowsFormsEditorService _EditorService;

		public ListBox AxesListBox
		{
			get
			{
				return _AxesListBox;
			}
			set
			{
				_AxesListBox = value;
			}
		}

		private IWindowsFormsEditorService EditorService
		{
			get
			{
				return _EditorService;
			}
			set
			{
				_EditorService = value;
			}
		}

		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
		{
			if (context != null && context.Instance != null && provider != null)
			{
				object result = null;
				if (context.PropertyDescriptor != null)
				{
					result = context.PropertyDescriptor.GetValue(context.Instance);
				}
				EditorService = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
				ChartLayerAppearance chartLayerAppearance = context.Instance as ChartLayerAppearance;
				if (EditorService != null && chartLayerAppearance != null && chartLayerAppearance.ChartArea != null && chartLayerAppearance.ChartArea.Axes != null)
				{
					AxesListBox = new ListBox();
					foreach (AxisItem item in (IEnumerable)chartLayerAppearance.ChartArea.Axes)
					{
						AxesListBox.Items.Add(item);
					}
					AxesListBox.SelectedIndexChanged += AxisChanged;
					EditorService.DropDownControl(AxesListBox);
					if (AxesListBox.SelectedItem != null)
					{
						return AxesListBox.SelectedItem;
					}
					return result;
				}
			}
			return base.EditValue(context, provider, value);
		}

		private void AxisChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			EditorService.CloseDropDown();
		}

		public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return UITypeEditorEditStyle.DropDown;
		}
	}

		{
			get

			}
			set
			{
				_EditorService = value;
			}
		}

		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
		{
			if (context != null && context.Instance != null && provider != null)
			{
				EditorService = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
				IProvideChartComponent provideChartComponent = context.Instance as IProvideChartComponent;
				if (EditorService != null && provideChartComponent != null && provideChartComponent.ChartComponent != null)
				{
					ChartAreaCollection chartAreas = ((CompositeChartAppearance)provideChartComponent.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Composite)).ChartAreas;
					ChartAreasListBox = new ListBox();
					foreach (ChartArea item in (IEnumerable)chartAreas)
					{
						ChartAreasListBox.Items.Add(item);
					}
					ChartAreasListBox.SelectedIndexChanged += ChartAreaChanged;
					EditorService.DropDownControl(ChartAreasListBox);
					if (ChartAreasListBox.SelectedItem != null)
					{
						return ChartAreasListBox.SelectedItem;
					}
				}
			}
			return base.EditValue(context, provider, value);
		}

		{
			EditorService.CloseDropDown();
		}

		{
			return UITypeEditorEditStyle.DropDown;
		}

					_designForm.Controls.Add(listBox);
					listBox.Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
					((Control)(object)ultraButton).Click += OkButtonClick;
					listBox.Items.AddRange(chartLayers.ToArray());
					for (int i = 0; i < listBox.Items.Count; i++)
					{
						if (listBox.Items[i] is ChartLayerAppearance chartLayerAppearance && chartLayerCollection.FromKey(chartLayerAppearance.Key) != null)
						{
							listBox.SetSelected(i, value: true);
						}
					}
					_designForm.Visible = false;
					_designForm.Opacity = 100.0;
					if (_designForm.ShowDialog() == DialogResult.OK)
					{
						chartLayerCollection.Clear();
						foreach (ChartLayerAppearance selectedItem in listBox.SelectedItems)
						{
							chartLayerCollection.Add(selectedItem);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void OkButtonClick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_designForm.DialogResult = DialogResult.OK;
			_designForm.Close();
		}

		[ComVisible(false)]
		[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
		public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			if (context != null && context.Instance != null)
			{
				return UITypeEditorEditStyle.Modal;
			}
			return base.GetEditStyle(context);
		}

		[ComVisible(false)]
		[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
		public override bool GetPaintValueSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

	internal sealed class DataPointCollectionEditorForm : ChartCollectionEditorBaseForm
	{
		private static int ganttItemCounter;

		private Label label1;

		private Container components;

		protected override string[] TypeNames
		{
			get
			{
				string text;
				if (base.Collection is NumericDataPointCollection)
				{
					text = "Numeric DataPoint";
				}
				else if (base.Collection is XYDataPointCollection)
				{
					text = "XY DataPoint";
				}
				else if (base.Collection is XYZDataPointCollection)
				{
					text = "XYZ DataPoint";
				}
				else if (base.Collection is NumericTimeDataPointCollection)
				{
					text = "Numeric/Time DataPoint";
				}
				else if (base.Collection is CandleDataPointCollection)
				{
					text = "Candle DataPoint";
				}
				else if (base.Collection is GanttItemCollection)
				{
					text = "Gantt Item";
				}
				else if (base.Collection is BoxSetCollection)
				{
					text = "Box Set";
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(base.Collection is TreeMapDataPointCollection))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("Unrecognized series type.");
					}
					text = "TreeMap DataPoint";
				}
				return new string[1] { text };
			}
		}

		protected override Type[] ItemTypes
		{
			get
			{
				Type typeFromHandle;
				if (base.Collection is NumericDataPointCollection)
				{
					typeFromHandle = typeof(NumericDataPoint);
				}
				else if (base.Collection is XYDataPointCollection)
				{
					typeFromHandle = typeof(XYDataPoint);
				}
				else if (base.Collection is XYZDataPointCollection)
				{
					typeFromHandle = typeof(XYZDataPoint);
				}
				else if (base.Collection is NumericTimeDataPointCollection)
				{
					typeFromHandle = typeof(NumericTimeDataPoint);
				}
				else if (base.Collection is CandleDataPointCollection)
				{
					typeFromHandle = typeof(CandleDataPoint);
				}
				else if (base.Collection is GanttItemCollection)
				{
					typeFromHandle = typeof(GanttItem);
				}
				else if (base.Collection is BoxSetCollection)
				{
					typeFromHandle = typeof(BoxSet);
				}
				else if (base.Collection is FourDimensionalNumericDataPointCollection)
				{
					typeFromHandle = typeof(FourDimensionalNumericDataPoint);
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(base.Collection is TreeMapDataPointCollection))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("Unrecognized series type.");
					}
					typeFromHandle = typeof(TreeMapDataPoint);
				}
				return new Type[1] { typeFromHandle };
			}
		}

		protected override void AddItem(Type type)
		{
			if (type == typeof(GanttItem))
			{
				ganttItemCounter++;
				GanttItem ganttItem = new GanttItem("item" + ganttItemCounter);
				base.Collection.Add(ganttItem);
				listBox.SelectedIndex = listBox.Items.Add(ganttItem);
			}
			else if (base.Collection is BoxSetCollection)
			{
				BoxSet boxSet = new BoxSet();
				((BoxSetCollection)base.Collection).Add(boxSet);
				listBox.SelectedIndex = listBox.Items.Add(boxSet);
			}
			else
			{
				base.AddItem(type);
			}
		}

			: base(collection, property)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
		}

		{
			if (disposing && components != null)
			{
				components.Dispose();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	public class DropDownListBox : ListBox
	{
		private bool wasItemClicked;

		private bool populating;

		public bool WasItemClicked => wasItemClicked;

		public DropDownListBox(object[] items, object defaultItem, bool sorted)
		{
			base.BorderStyle = BorderStyle.None;
			base.Visible = true;
			base.Sorted = sorted;
			Populate(items, defaultItem);
		}

		public DropDownListBox(object[] items, object defaultItem)
			: this(items, defaultItem, sorted: true)
		{
		}

		protected override bool IsInputKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			if (keyData == Keys.Return)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.IsInputKey(keyData);
		}

		protected override void OnClick(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!populating)
			{
				wasItemClicked = true;
			}
			base.OnClick(e);
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Return)
			{
				wasItemClicked = true;
				OnClick(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnKeyDown(e);
			}
		}

		private void Populate(object[] items, object defaultItem)
		{
			if (items != null)
			{
				populating = true;
				foreach (object item in items)
				{
					base.Items.Add(item);
				}
				if (defaultItem != null)
				{
					SelectedIndex = base.Items.IndexOf(defaultItem);
				}
				populating = false;
			}
		}
	}

	[ComVisible(false)]
	[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
	public abstract class EnumEditor : UITypeEditor
	{
		private IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc;

		protected abstract Type EnumType { get; }

		public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return UITypeEditorEditStyle.DropDown;
		}

		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
		{
			if (context != null && context.Instance != null && provider != null)
			{
				edSvc = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
				if (edSvc != null && value != null && value.GetType() == EnumType)
				{
					InitializeMembers(context);
					DropDownListBox dropDownListBox = CreateListBox((Enum)value);
					if (dropDownListBox.PreferredHeight < dropDownListBox.Height)
					{
						dropDownListBox.Height = dropDownListBox.PreferredHeight;
					}
					edSvc.DropDownControl(dropDownListBox);
					if (dropDownListBox.SelectedItem != null && dropDownListBox.WasItemClicked)
					{
						value = dropDownListBox.SelectedItem;
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		public override bool GetPaintValueSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override void PaintValue(PaintValueEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Value != null)
			{
				InitializeMembers(e.Context);
				PaintEnum((Enum)e.Value, e.Bounds, e.Graphics);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeMembers(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeListBox(ListBox listbox)
		{
			listbox.ItemHeight = 18;
		}

		protected virtual void OnDrawItem(object sender, DrawItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is ListBox listBox)
			{
				e.DrawBackground();
				Enum obj = (Enum)listBox.Items[e.Index];
				Size size = new Size(20, e.Bounds.Height - 2);
				Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(e.Bounds.Location, size);
				rect.Offset(1, 1);
				PaintEnum(obj, rect, e.Graphics);
				StringFormat stringFormat = new StringFormat(StringFormatFlags.NoWrap);
				stringFormat.LineAlignment = StringAlignment.Center;
				stringFormat.Alignment = StringAlignment.Near;
				Type type = obj.GetType();
				string name = Enum.GetName(type, obj);
				Brush brush = new SolidBrush(e.ForeColor);
				Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(rect.Right + 1, e.Bounds.Top, e.Bounds.Width - (rect.Right + 1), e.Bounds.Height);
				e.Graphics.DrawString(name, e.Font, brush, rectangle, stringFormat);
				brush.Dispose();
				stringFormat.Dispose();
				if ((e.State & DrawItemState.Focus) != DrawItemState.None)
				{
					e.DrawFocusRectangle();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PaintEnum(Enum value, Rectangle rect, Graphics g)
		{
		}

		private DropDownListBox CreateListBox(Enum defaultItem)
		{
			DropDownListBox dropDownListBox = null;
			object[] enumValues = GetEnumValues(defaultItem);
			dropDownListBox = new DropDownListBox(enumValues, defaultItem, sorted: false);
			dropDownListBox.Click += OnListClick;
			dropDownListBox.DrawItem += OnDrawItem;
			dropDownListBox.DrawMode = DrawMode.OwnerDrawFixed;
			InitializeListBox(dropDownListBox);
			return dropDownListBox;
		}

		protected virtual object[] GetEnumValues(Enum defaultItem)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			Type type = defaultItem.GetType();
			Enum.GetValues(type);
			FieldInfo[] fields = type.GetFields();
			FieldInfo[] array = fields;
			foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in array)
			{
				if (fieldInfo.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(BrowsableFieldAttribute), inherit: false).Length == 0)
				{
					object value = fieldInfo.GetValue(defaultItem);
					if (value is Enum)
					{
						arrayList.Add(value);
					}
				}
			}
			return (object[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(object));
		}

		private void OnListClick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (edSvc != null)
			{
				edSvc.CloseDropDown();
			}
		}
	}
	[ComVisible(false)]
	[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
	public class HatchEditor : EnumEditor
	{
		protected override Type EnumType => typeof(FillHatchStyle);

		protected override void PaintEnum(Enum value, Rectangle rect, Graphics g)
		{
			FillHatchStyle fillHatchStyle = (FillHatchStyle)(object)value;
			if (fillHatchStyle != FillHatchStyle.Default && fillHatchStyle != FillHatchStyle.None)
			{
				PaintElement paintElement = new PaintElement();
				paintElement.ElementType = PaintElementType.Hatch;
				paintElement.FillStopColor = Color.FromKnownColor(KnownColor.Window);
				if (paintElement.FillStopColor.B < 128)
				{
					paintElement.Fill = Color.Blue;
				}
				else
				{
					paintElement.Fill = Color.Orange;
				}
				paintElement.Hatch = (FillHatchStyle)(object)value;
				paintElement.FillGradientStyle = GradientStyle.None;
				Brush brush = PaintElement.GetBrush(paintElement, rect);
				g.FillRectangle(brush, rect);
			}
		}
	}
	[ComVisible(false)]
	[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
	public class GradientEditor : EnumEditor
	{
		protected override Type EnumType => typeof(GradientStyle);

		protected override void PaintEnum(Enum value, Rectangle rect, Graphics g)
		{
			PaintElement paintElement = new PaintElement();
			paintElement.ElementType = PaintElementType.Gradient;
			GradientStyle gradientStyle = (GradientStyle)(object)value;
			switch (gradientStyle)
			{
			case GradientStyle.Raise:
			{
				GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPath.AddRectangle(rect);
				Brush brush = PaintElement.GetHilightBrush(paintElement, graphicsPath, Color.FromArgb(150, Color.Blue));
				g.FillRectangle(brush, rect);
				graphicsPath.Dispose();
				break;
			}
			default:
			{
				paintElement.Fill = Color.Blue;
				paintElement.FillStopColor = Color.Red;
				paintElement.FillGradientStyle = gradientStyle;
				Brush brush = PaintElement.GetBrush(paintElement, rect);
				g.FillRectangle(brush, rect);
				break;
			}
			case GradientStyle.Default:
			case GradientStyle.None:
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	[ComVisible(false)]
	[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
	public class PaintElementTypeEditor : EnumEditor
	{
		protected override Type EnumType => typeof(PaintElementType);

		protected override void PaintEnum(Enum value, Rectangle rect, Graphics g)
		{
			if ((PaintElementType)(object)value != PaintElementType.None)
			{
				PaintElement paintElement = new PaintElement();
				paintElement.Fill = Color.Blue;
				paintElement.FillStopColor = Color.Red;
				paintElement.FillGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)(object)value;
				Brush brush = PaintElement.GetBrush(paintElement, rect);
				if (brush == null)
				{
					brush = Brushes.Red;
				}
				g.FillRectangle(brush, rect);
			}
		}
	}
	[ComVisible(false)]
	[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
	public class TextureEditor : EnumEditor
	{
		protected override Type EnumType => typeof(TexturePresets);

		protected override void PaintEnum(Enum value, Rectangle rect, Graphics g)
		{
			TexturePresets texturePresets = (TexturePresets)(object)value;
			if (texturePresets != TexturePresets.CustomImage)
			{
				PaintElement paintElement = new PaintElement();
				paintElement.ElementType = PaintElementType.Texture;
				paintElement.Fill = Color.LightSkyBlue;
				paintElement.Texture = texturePresets;
				Brush brush = PaintElement.GetBrush(paintElement, rect);
				if (brush == null)
				{
					brush = Brushes.Red;
				}
				g.FillRectangle(brush, rect);
			}
		}
	}

	public class GridControl : ChartEditorControlBase
	{
		private enum DragType
		{
			Extent,
			MarginNear,
			MarginFar
		}

		private ChartGridAppearance _Grid;

		private PaintElement _pE = new PaintElement(Color.Black);

		private Point topLeft;

		private Point topRight;

		private Point bottomLeft;

		private Point bottomRight;

		private int xNear;

		private int xFar;

		private int yNear;

		private int yFar;

		private int x2Near;

		private int x2Far;

		private int y2Near;

		private int y2Far;

		private AxisAppearance draggingAxis;

		private DragType _dragType;

		public ChartGridAppearance Grid
		{
			get
			{
				return _Grid;
			}
			set
			{
				_Grid = value;
			}
		}

		public PaintElement PE
		{
			get
			{
				return _pE;
			}
			set
			{
				_pE = value;
			}
		}

		public GridControl()
		{
		}

		public GridControl(ChartUIEditorBase ed)
			: base(ed)
		{
		}

		public override void SetValue(object val)
		{
			Grid = val as ChartGridAppearance;
		}

		public override object GetValue()
		{
			return Grid;
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPaint(e);
			Brush brush = PaintElement.GetBrush(PE, base.ClientRectangle);
			if (Grid != null)
			{
				e.Graphics.Clear(BackColor);
				RecordGridCorners();
				RecordMarginLocations();
				int triSize = 5;
				int triSize2 = 4;
				int num = 1;
				if (Grid.X2.Visible)
				{
					e.Graphics.FillPolygon(new SolidBrush(SystemColors.GrayText), GetTriangle1(Grid.X2, triSize2, num * 3));
					e.Graphics.DrawLine(new Pen(Grid.X2.LineColor, Math.Max(Grid.X2.LineThickness, 1)), topLeft, topRight);
					e.Graphics.FillPolygon(brush, GetNearTri(Grid.X2, triSize, num));
					e.Graphics.FillPolygon(brush, GetFarTri(Grid.X2, triSize, num));
				}
				if (Grid.Y.Visible)
				{
					e.Graphics.FillPolygon(new SolidBrush(SystemColors.GrayText), GetTriangle1(Grid.Y, triSize2, num * 3));
					e.Graphics.DrawLine(new Pen(Grid.Y.LineColor, Math.Max(Grid.Y.LineThickness, 1)), topLeft, bottomLeft);
					e.Graphics.FillPolygon(brush, GetNearTri(Grid.Y, triSize, num));
					e.Graphics.FillPolygon(brush, GetFarTri(Grid.Y, triSize, num));
				}
				if (Grid.Y2.Visible)
				{
					e.Graphics.FillPolygon(new SolidBrush(SystemColors.GrayText), GetTriangle1(Grid.Y2, triSize2, num * 3));
					e.Graphics.DrawLine(new Pen(Grid.Y2.LineColor, Math.Max(Grid.Y2.LineThickness, 1)), topRight, bottomRight);
					e.Graphics.FillPolygon(brush, GetNearTri(Grid.Y2, triSize, num));
					e.Graphics.FillPolygon(brush, GetFarTri(Grid.Y2, triSize, num));
				}
				if (Grid.X.Visible)
				{
					e.Graphics.FillPolygon(new SolidBrush(SystemColors.GrayText), GetTriangle1(Grid.X, triSize2, num * 3));
					e.Graphics.DrawLine(new Pen(Grid.X.LineColor, Math.Max(Grid.X.LineThickness, 1)), bottomLeft, bottomRight);
					e.Graphics.FillPolygon(brush, GetNearTri(Grid.X, triSize, num));
					e.Graphics.FillPolygon(brush, GetFarTri(Grid.X, triSize, num));
				}
			}
		}

		private Point[] GetTriangle1(AxisAppearance axis, int triSize, int triOffset)
		{
			if (axis == Grid.X)
			{
				int num = bottomRight.X - bottomLeft.X;
				return new Point[10]
				{
					new Point(bottomLeft.X + num / 2 - triSize, bottomLeft.Y - triOffset),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X + num / 2, bottomLeft.Y - triOffset - triSize),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X + num / 2 + triSize, bottomLeft.Y - triOffset),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X + num / 2 + triSize / 4, bottomLeft.Y - triOffset),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X + num / 2 + triSize / 4, bottomLeft.Y + triOffset),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X + num / 2 + triSize, bottomLeft.Y + triOffset),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X + num / 2, bottomLeft.Y + triOffset + triSize),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X + num / 2 - triSize, bottomLeft.Y + triOffset),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X + num / 2 - triSize / 4, bottomLeft.Y + triOffset),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X + num / 2 - triSize / 4, bottomLeft.Y - triOffset)
				};
			}
			if (axis == Grid.Y)
			{
				int num2 = bottomLeft.Y - topLeft.Y;
				return new Point[10]
				{
					new Point(topLeft.X - triOffset, topLeft.Y + num2 / 2 - triSize),
					new Point(topLeft.X - triOffset - triSize, topLeft.Y + num2 / 2),
					new Point(topLeft.X - triOffset, topLeft.Y + num2 / 2 + triSize),
					new Point(topLeft.X - triOffset, topLeft.Y + num2 / 2 + triSize / 4),
					new Point(topLeft.X + triOffset, topLeft.Y + num2 / 2 + triSize / 4),
					new Point(topLeft.X + triOffset, topLeft.Y + num2 / 2 + triSize),
					new Point(topLeft.X + triOffset + triSize, topLeft.Y + num2 / 2),
					new Point(topLeft.X + triOffset, topLeft.Y + num2 / 2 - triSize),
					new Point(topLeft.X + triOffset, topLeft.Y + num2 / 2 - triSize / 4),
					new Point(topLeft.X - triOffset, topLeft.Y + num2 / 2 - triSize / 4)
				};
			}
			if (axis == Grid.X2)
			{
				int num3 = topRight.X - topLeft.X;
				return new Point[10]
				{
					new Point(topLeft.X + num3 / 2 - triSize, topLeft.Y - triOffset),
					new Point(topLeft.X + num3 / 2, topLeft.Y - triOffset - triSize),
					new Point(topLeft.X + num3 / 2 + triSize, topLeft.Y - triOffset),
					new Point(topLeft.X + num3 / 2 + triSize / 4, topLeft.Y - triOffset),
					new Point(topLeft.X + num3 / 2 + triSize / 4, topLeft.Y + triOffset),
					new Point(topLeft.X + num3 / 2 + triSize, topLeft.Y + triOffset),
					new Point(topLeft.X + num3 / 2, topLeft.Y + triOffset + triSize),
					new Point(topLeft.X + num3 / 2 - triSize, topLeft.Y + triOffset),
					new Point(topLeft.X + num3 / 2 - triSize / 4, topLeft.Y + triOffset),
					new Point(topLeft.X + num3 / 2 - triSize / 4, topLeft.Y - triOffset)
				};
			}
			int num4 = bottomRight.Y - topRight.Y;
			return new Point[10]
			{
				new Point(topRight.X - triOffset, topRight.Y + num4 / 2 - triSize),
				new Point(topRight.X - triOffset - triSize, topRight.Y + num4 / 2),
				new Point(topRight.X - triOffset, topRight.Y + num4 / 2 + triSize),
				new Point(topRight.X - triOffset, topRight.Y + num4 / 2 + triSize / 4),
				new Point(topRight.X + triOffset, topRight.Y + num4 / 2 + triSize / 4),
				new Point(topRight.X + triOffset, topRight.Y + num4 / 2 + triSize),
				new Point(topRight.X + triOffset + triSize, topRight.Y + num4 / 2),
				new Point(topRight.X + triOffset, topRight.Y + num4 / 2 - triSize),
				new Point(topRight.X + triOffset, topRight.Y + num4 / 2 - triSize / 4),
				new Point(topRight.X - triOffset, topRight.Y + num4 / 2 - triSize / 4)
			};
		}

		private Point[] GetTriangle2(AxisAppearance axis, int triSize, int triOffset)
		{
			if (axis == Grid.X)
			{
				int num = bottomRight.X - bottomLeft.X;
				return new Point[3]
				{
					new Point(bottomLeft.X + num / 2, bottomLeft.Y + triOffset + triSize),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X + num / 2 - triSize * 2, bottomLeft.Y + triOffset),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X + num / 2 + triSize * 2, bottomLeft.Y + triOffset)
				};
			}
			if (axis != Grid.Y)
			{
				_ = Grid.X2;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private Point[] GetFarTri(AxisAppearance axis, int triSize, int triOffset)
		{
			if (axis == Grid.X)
			{
				return new Point[5]
				{
					new Point(xFar - triSize, bottomLeft.Y + triSize * 2 + triOffset),
					new Point(xFar - triSize, bottomLeft.Y + triSize + triOffset),
					new Point(xFar, bottomLeft.Y + triOffset),
					new Point(xFar + triSize, bottomLeft.Y + triSize + triOffset),
					new Point(xFar + triSize, bottomLeft.Y + triSize * 2 + triOffset)
				};
			}
			if (axis == Grid.Y)
			{
				return new Point[5]
				{
					new Point(bottomLeft.X - triSize * 2 - triOffset, yFar - triSize),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X - triSize - triOffset, yFar - triSize),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X - triOffset, yFar),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X - triSize - triOffset, yFar + triSize),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X - triSize * 2 - triOffset, yFar + triSize)
				};
			}
			if (axis == Grid.X2)
			{
				return new Point[5]
				{
					new Point(x2Far - triSize, topLeft.Y - triSize * 2 - triOffset),
					new Point(x2Far - triSize, topLeft.Y - triSize - triOffset),
					new Point(x2Far, topLeft.Y - triOffset),
					new Point(x2Far + triSize, topLeft.Y - triSize - triOffset),
					new Point(x2Far + triSize, topLeft.Y - triSize * 2 - triOffset)
				};
			}
			return new Point[5]
			{
				new Point(bottomRight.X + triSize * 2 + triOffset, y2Far - triSize),
				new Point(bottomRight.X + triSize + triOffset, y2Far - triSize),
				new Point(bottomRight.X + triOffset, y2Far),
				new Point(bottomRight.X + triSize + triOffset, y2Far + triSize),
				new Point(bottomRight.X + triSize * 2 + triOffset, y2Far + triSize)
			};
		}

		private Point[] GetNearTri(AxisAppearance axis, int triSize, int triOffset)
		{
			if (axis == Grid.X)
			{
				return new Point[5]
				{
					new Point(xNear - triSize, bottomLeft.Y + triSize * 2 + triOffset),
					new Point(xNear - triSize, bottomLeft.Y + triSize + triOffset),
					new Point(xNear, bottomLeft.Y + triOffset),
					new Point(xNear + triSize, bottomLeft.Y + triSize + triOffset),
					new Point(xNear + triSize, bottomLeft.Y + triSize * 2 + triOffset)
				};
			}
			if (axis == Grid.Y)
			{
				return new Point[5]
				{
					new Point(bottomLeft.X - triSize * 2 - triOffset, yNear - triSize),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X - triSize - triOffset, yNear - triSize),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X - triOffset, yNear),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X - triSize - triOffset, yNear + triSize),
					new Point(bottomLeft.X - triSize * 2 - triOffset, yNear + triSize)
				};
			}
			if (axis == Grid.X2)
			{
				return new Point[5]
				{
					new Point(x2Near - triSize, topLeft.Y - triSize * 2 - triOffset),
					new Point(x2Near - triSize, topLeft.Y - triSize - triOffset),
					new Point(x2Near, topLeft.Y - triOffset),
					new Point(x2Near + triSize, topLeft.Y - triSize - triOffset),
					new Point(x2Near + triSize, topLeft.Y - triSize * 2 - triOffset)
				};
			}
			return new Point[5]
			{
				new Point(bottomRight.X + triSize * 2 + triOffset, y2Near - triSize),
				new Point(bottomRight.X + triSize + triOffset, y2Near - triSize),
				new Point(bottomRight.X + triOffset, y2Near),
				new Point(bottomRight.X + triSize + triOffset, y2Near + triSize),
				new Point(bottomRight.X + triSize * 2 + triOffset, y2Near + triSize)
			};
		}

		private void RecordGridCorners()
		{
			int num = base.Top;
			if (Grid.X2.Visible)
			{
				num += Grid.X2.Extent;
			}
			int num2 = base.Left;
			if (Grid.Y.Visible)
			{
				num2 += Grid.Y.Extent;
			}
			int num3 = base.Right;
			if (Grid.Y2.Visible)
			{
				num3 -= Grid.Y2.Extent;
			}
			int num4 = base.Bottom;
			if (Grid.X.Visible)
			{
				num4 -= Grid.X.Extent;
			}
			int num5 = 15;
			if (!Grid.X2.Visible)
			{
				num += num5;
			}
			if (!Grid.Y.Visible)
			{
				num2 += num5;
			}
			if (!Grid.Y2.Visible)
			{
				num3 -= num5;
			}
			if (!Grid.X.Visible)
			{
				num4 -= num5;
			}
			topLeft = new Point(num2, num);
			topRight = new Point(num3, num);
			bottomLeft = new Point(num2, num4);
			bottomRight = new Point(num3, num4);
		}

		private void RecordMarginLocations()
		{
			xNear = GetAxisNear(Grid.X);
			yNear = GetAxisNear(Grid.Y);
			x2Near = GetAxisNear(Grid.X2);
			y2Near = GetAxisNear(Grid.Y2);
			xFar = GetAxisFar(Grid.X);
			yFar = GetAxisFar(Grid.Y);
			x2Far = GetAxisFar(Grid.X2);
			y2Far = GetAxisFar(Grid.Y2);
		}

		private void SetAxisFar(AxisAppearance axis, int n)
		{
			if (axis.Margin.Far.MarginType == LocationType.RowColumn || axis.Margin.Far.MarginType == LocationType.DataValues)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			if (axis == Grid.X)
			{
				num = bottomLeft.X;
				num2 = bottomRight.X;
			}
			else if (axis == Grid.Y)
			{
				num = bottomLeft.Y;
				num2 = topLeft.Y;
				flag = true;
			}
			else if (axis == Grid.X2)
			{
				num = topLeft.X;
				num2 = topRight.X;
			}
			else if (axis == Grid.Y2)
			{
				num = bottomRight.Y;
				num2 = topRight.Y;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (axis.Margin.Near.MarginType == LocationType.Percentage)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					axis.Margin.Far.Value = 100.0 * ((double)(n - num2) / (double)(num - num2));
				}
				else
				{
					axis.Margin.Far.Value = 100.0 * ((double)(num2 - n) / (double)(num2 - num));
				}
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				axis.Margin.Far.Value = n - num2;
			}
			else
			{
				axis.Margin.Far.Value = num2 - n;
			}
			RefreshChart();
		}

		private int GetAxisFar(AxisAppearance axis)
		{
			if (axis.Margin.Far.MarginType == LocationType.RowColumn || axis.Margin.Far.MarginType == LocationType.DataValues)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			if (axis == Grid.X)
			{
				num = bottomLeft.X;
				num2 = bottomRight.X;
			}
			else if (axis == Grid.Y)
			{
				num = bottomLeft.Y;
				num2 = topLeft.Y;
				flag = true;
			}
			else if (axis == Grid.X2)
			{
				num = topLeft.X;
				num2 = topRight.X;
			}
			else if (axis == Grid.Y2)
			{
				num = bottomRight.Y;
				num2 = topRight.Y;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (axis.Margin.Far.MarginType == LocationType.Percentage)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					return (int)((double)num2 + (double)(num - num2) * (axis.Margin.Far.Value / 100.0));
				}
				return (int)((double)num2 - (double)(num2 - num) * (axis.Margin.Far.Value / 100.0));
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return (int)((double)num2 + axis.Margin.Far.Value);
			}
			return (int)((double)num2 - axis.Margin.Far.Value);
		}

		private void SetAxisNear(AxisAppearance axis, int n)
		{
			if (axis.Margin.Near.MarginType == LocationType.RowColumn || axis.Margin.Near.MarginType == LocationType.DataValues)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			if (axis == Grid.X)
			{
				num = bottomLeft.X;
				num2 = bottomRight.X;
			}
			else if (axis == Grid.Y)
			{
				num = bottomLeft.Y;
				num2 = topLeft.Y;
				flag = true;
			}
			else if (axis == Grid.X2)
			{
				num = topLeft.X;
				num2 = topRight.X;
			}
			else if (axis == Grid.Y2)
			{
				num = bottomRight.Y;
				num2 = topRight.Y;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (axis.Margin.Near.MarginType == LocationType.Percentage)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					axis.Margin.Near.Value = 100.0 * ((double)(num - n) / (double)(num - num2));
				}
				else
				{
					axis.Margin.Near.Value = 100.0 * ((double)(n - num) / (double)(num2 - num));
				}
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				axis.Margin.Near.Value = n - num;
			}
			else
			{
				axis.Margin.Near.Value = n + num;
			}
			RefreshChart();
		}

		private int GetAxisNear(AxisAppearance axis)
		{
			if (axis.Margin.Near.MarginType == LocationType.RowColumn || axis.Margin.Near.MarginType == LocationType.DataValues)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			if (axis == Grid.X)
			{
				num = bottomLeft.X;
				num2 = bottomRight.X;
			}
			else if (axis == Grid.Y)
			{
				num = bottomLeft.Y;
				num2 = topLeft.Y;
				flag = true;
			}
			else if (axis == Grid.X2)
			{
				num = topLeft.X;
				num2 = topRight.X;
			}
			else if (axis == Grid.Y2)
			{
				num = bottomRight.Y;
				num2 = topRight.Y;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (axis.Margin.Near.MarginType == LocationType.Percentage)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					return (int)((double)num - (double)(num - num2) * (axis.Margin.Near.Value / 100.0));
				}
				return (int)((double)num + (double)(num2 - num) * (axis.Margin.Near.Value / 100.0));
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return (int)((double)num - axis.Margin.Near.Value);
			}
			return (int)((double)num + axis.Margin.Near.Value);
		}

		private bool OverXScroller(int y)
		{
			if (Grid.X.Visible && y - bottomLeft.Y < 8)
			{
				return y - bottomLeft.Y > -1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool OverX(int y)
		{
			if (Grid.X.Visible && bottomLeft.Y - y < 4)
			{
				return bottomLeft.Y - y > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool OverX2Scroller(int y)
		{
			if (Grid.X2.Visible && topRight.Y - y < 8)
			{
				return topRight.Y - y > -1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool OverX2(int y)
		{
			if (Grid.X2.Visible && y - topRight.Y < 4)
			{
				return y - topRight.Y > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool OverYScroller(int x)
		{
			if (Grid.Y.Visible && bottomLeft.X - x < 8)
			{
				return bottomLeft.X - x > -1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool OverY2Scroller(int x)
		{
			if (Grid.Y2.Visible && x - bottomRight.X < 8)
			{
				return x - bottomRight.X > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool OverY(int x)
		{
			if (Grid.Y.Visible && x - topLeft.X < 4)
			{
				return x - topLeft.X > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool OverY2(int x)
		{
			if (Grid.Y2.Visible && topRight.X - x < 4)
			{
				return topRight.X - x > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool OverNear(AxisAppearance axis, int n)
		{
			int num = 3;
			return Math.Abs(GetAxisNear(axis) - n) <= num;
		}

		private bool OverFar(AxisAppearance axis, int n)
		{
			int num = 3;
			return Math.Abs(GetAxisFar(axis) - n) <= num;
		}

		private void SetExtent(AxisAppearance axis, int value)
		{
			axis.Extent = value;
			RefreshChart();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.X < 0 || e.X > base.Right || e.Y < 0 || e.Y > base.Bottom)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (draggingAxis != null)
			{
				if (_dragType == DragType.Extent)
				{
					if (e.X < 15 || e.X > base.Right - 15 || e.Y < 7 || e.Y > base.Bottom - 22)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				else if (e.X < 0 || e.X > base.Right - 10 || e.Y < 0 || e.Y > base.Bottom - 10)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (draggingAxis == Grid.X)
				{
					if (_dragType == DragType.Extent)
					{
						SetExtent(Grid.X, Math.Min(Math.Max(base.Bottom - e.Y, 0), 500));
					}
					else if (_dragType == DragType.MarginNear)
					{
						SetAxisNear(Grid.X, e.X);
					}
					else if (_dragType == DragType.MarginFar)
					{
						SetAxisFar(Grid.X, e.X);
					}
				}
				else if (draggingAxis == Grid.Y)
				{
					if (_dragType == DragType.Extent)
					{
						SetExtent(Grid.Y, Math.Min(Math.Max(base.Left - 23 + e.X, 0), 500));
					}
					else if (_dragType == DragType.MarginNear)
					{
						SetAxisNear(Grid.Y, e.Y);
					}
					else if (_dragType == DragType.MarginFar)
					{
						SetAxisFar(Grid.Y, e.Y);
					}
				}
				else if (draggingAxis == Grid.X2)
				{
					if (_dragType == DragType.Extent)
					{
						SetExtent(Grid.X2, Math.Min(Math.Max(base.Top - 15 + e.Y, 0), 500));
					}
					else if (_dragType == DragType.MarginNear)
					{
						SetAxisNear(Grid.X2, e.X);
					}
					else if (_dragType == DragType.MarginFar)
					{
						SetAxisFar(Grid.X2, e.X);
					}
				}
				else if (draggingAxis == Grid.Y2)
				{
					if (_dragType == DragType.Extent)
					{
						SetExtent(Grid.Y2, Math.Min(Math.Max(base.Right + 7 - e.X, 0), 500));
					}
					else if (_dragType == DragType.MarginNear)
					{
						SetAxisNear(Grid.Y2, e.Y);
					}
					else if (_dragType == DragType.MarginFar)
					{
						SetAxisFar(Grid.Y2, e.Y);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				bool flag = OverY(e.X) || OverY2(e.X);
				bool flag2 = OverX(e.Y) || OverX2(e.Y);
				bool flag3 = OverYScroller(e.X) || OverY2Scroller(e.X);
				bool flag4 = OverXScroller(e.Y) || OverX2Scroller(e.Y);
				if (flag3)
				{
					Cursor = Cursors.Hand;
				}
				else if (flag4)
				{
					Cursor = Cursors.Hand;
				}
				else if (flag)
				{
					Cursor = Cursors.VSplit;
				}
				else if (flag2)
				{
					Cursor = Cursors.HSplit;
				}
				else
				{
					Cursor = Cursors.Default;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			int num = 5;
			bool flag = OverX(e.Y);
			bool flag2 = OverXScroller(e.Y) && Math.Abs(e.X - GetAxisNear(Grid.X)) <= num;
			bool flag3 = OverXScroller(e.Y) && Math.Abs(e.X - GetAxisFar(Grid.X)) <= num;
			bool flag4 = OverY(e.X);
			bool flag5 = OverYScroller(e.X) && Math.Abs(e.Y - GetAxisNear(Grid.Y)) <= num;
			bool flag6 = OverYScroller(e.X) && Math.Abs(e.Y - GetAxisFar(Grid.Y)) <= num;
			bool flag7 = OverX2(e.Y);
			bool flag8 = OverX2Scroller(e.Y) && Math.Abs(e.X - GetAxisNear(Grid.X2)) <= num;
			bool flag9 = OverX2Scroller(e.Y) && Math.Abs(e.X - GetAxisFar(Grid.X2)) <= num;
			bool flag10 = OverY2(e.X);
			bool flag11 = OverY2Scroller(e.X) && Math.Abs(e.Y - GetAxisNear(Grid.Y2)) <= num;
			bool flag12 = OverY2Scroller(e.X) && Math.Abs(e.Y - GetAxisFar(Grid.Y2)) <= num;
			if (flag2)
			{
				draggingAxis = Grid.X;
				_dragType = DragType.MarginNear;
			}
			else if (flag5)
			{
				draggingAxis = Grid.Y;
				_dragType = DragType.MarginNear;
			}
			else if (flag8)
			{
				draggingAxis = Grid.X2;
				_dragType = DragType.MarginNear;
			}
			else if (flag11)
			{
				draggingAxis = Grid.Y2;
				_dragType = DragType.MarginNear;
			}
			else if (flag3)
			{
				draggingAxis = Grid.X;
				_dragType = DragType.MarginFar;
			}
			else if (flag6)
			{
				draggingAxis = Grid.Y;
				_dragType = DragType.MarginFar;
			}
			else if (flag9)
			{
				draggingAxis = Grid.X2;
				_dragType = DragType.MarginFar;
			}
			else if (flag12)
			{
				draggingAxis = Grid.Y2;
				_dragType = DragType.MarginFar;
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				draggingAxis = Grid.X;
				_dragType = DragType.Extent;
			}
			else if (flag4)
			{
				draggingAxis = Grid.Y;
				_dragType = DragType.Extent;
			}
			else if (flag7)
			{
				draggingAxis = Grid.X2;
				_dragType = DragType.Extent;
			}
			else if (flag10)
			{
				draggingAxis = Grid.Y2;
				_dragType = DragType.Extent;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			draggingAxis = null;
			RefreshChart(forceful: true);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(EventArgs e)
		{
			Focus();
		}

		protected void RefreshChart()
		{
			RefreshChart(forceful: true);
		}

		protected void RefreshChart(bool forceful)
		{
			IChartComponent chartComponent = ((IProvideChartComponent)Grid).ChartComponent;
			if (chartComponent != null)
			{
				chartComponent.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
				if (chartComponent.Site != null)
				{
					if (chartComponent.Site.GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)) is IComponentChangeService componentChangeService)
					{
						PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(chartComponent);
						PropertyDescriptor member = properties.Find("Axis", ignoreCase: false);
						try
						{
							componentChangeService.OnComponentChanged(chartComponent, member, Grid, Grid);
						}
						catch (COMException)
						{
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					chartComponent.OnUpdated();
				}
			}
			Invalidate();
			Update();
		}
	}

		public GridControlEditorHost(ChartUIEditorBase ed)

	public class GridEditor : ChartUIEditorBase
	{
		public GridEditor()
			: base(typeof(GridControlEditorHost))
		{
		}

		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object val)
		{
			if (base.EditorControl.Parent != null)
			{
				RecreateEditorControl();
			}
			if (provider is GridItem)
			{
				((GridItem)provider).Expanded = false;
			}
			return base.EditValue(context, provider, val);
		}
	}
	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	public class StyleCtrl : ChartEditorControlBase
	{
		private SolidBrush backBrush;

		public SolidBrush hilightBrush = new SolidBrush(Color.Coral);

		public SolidBrush clickBrush = new SolidBrush(Color.Beige);

		protected Pen blackPen = new Pen(Color.Black, 2f);

		private Container components;

		public string[] names = new string[1] { "Style" };

		public Rectangle[] rects;

		public int hoverId = -1;

		public int clickId = -1;

		public StyleCtrl()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
		}

		public StyleCtrl(ChartUIEditorBase ed)
			: base(ed)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && components != null)
			{
				components.Dispose();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		private void InitializeComponent()
		{
			base.Name = "StyleCtrl";
			base.Size = new System.Drawing.Size(128, 224);
			base.Click += new System.EventHandler(StyleCtrl_Click);
			base.Load += new System.EventHandler(LineStyleCtrl_Load);
			base.Paint += new System.Windows.Forms.PaintEventHandler(LineStyleCtrl_Paint);
			base.MouseMove += new System.Windows.Forms.MouseEventHandler(LineStyleCtrl_MouseMove);
		}

		private void LineStyleCtrl_Paint(object sender, PaintEventArgs e)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < names.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i != hoverId && i != clickId)
				{
					e.Graphics.FillRectangle(backBrush, rects[i]);
					DrawRectUnHilight(e.Graphics, rects[i], i);
				}
				if (i == hoverId)
				{
					e.Graphics.FillRectangle(hilightBrush, rects[i]);
					DrawRectHilight(e.Graphics, rects[i], i);
				}
				if (i == clickId)
				{
					e.Graphics.FillRectangle(clickBrush, rects[i]);
					DrawRectClick(e.Graphics, rects[i], i);
				}
			}
		}

		private void LineStyleCtrl_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			int num = 5;
			int num2 = base.Size.Height;
			int num3 = base.Size.Width;
			int num4 = (num2 - num * names.Length) / names.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < names.Length; i++)
			{
				ref Rectangle reference = ref rects[i];
				reference = new Rectangle(0, (num4 + num) * i, num3, num4);
			}
			backBrush = new SolidBrush(BackColor);
		}

		private void LineStyleCtrl_MouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < names.Length; i++)
			{
				if (rects[i].Contains(e.X, e.Y))
				{
					num = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num > -1 && hoverId != num)
			{
				hoverId = num;
				Invalidate();
			}
		}

		private void StyleCtrl_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			clickId = hoverId;
			if (clickId > -1)
			{
				Invalidate();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void DrawRectHilight(Graphics g, Rectangle rect, int n)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void DrawRectUnHilight(Graphics g, Rectangle rect, int n)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void DrawRectClick(Graphics g, Rectangle rect, int n)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (names == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			if (clickId >= names.Length || clickId <= 0)
			{
				return "";
			}
			return names[clickId];
		}
	}
	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	public class LineCapStyleCtrl : StyleCtrl
	{
		private LineCapStyle ltype = LineCapStyle.Flat;

		public LineCapStyleCtrl(ChartUIEditorBase ed)
			: base(ed)
		{
			names = Enum.GetNames(typeof(LineCapStyle));
			rects = new Rectangle[Enum.GetValues(typeof(LineCapStyle)).Length];
			base.Size = base.Size;
			blackPen = new Pen(Color.Black, 5f);
		}

		public LineCapStyleCtrl()
		{
			names = Enum.GetNames(typeof(LineCapStyle));
			rects = new Rectangle[Enum.GetValues(typeof(LineCapStyle)).Length];
			base.Size = base.Size;
			blackPen = new Pen(Color.Black, 5f);
		}

		private void drawLine(Graphics g, Rectangle rect, int n)
		{
			blackPen.DashStyle = DashStyle.Solid;
			switch (n)
			{
			case 0:
				blackPen.EndCap = LineCap.NoAnchor;
				break;
			case 1:
				blackPen.EndCap = LineCap.ArrowAnchor;
				break;
			case 2:
				blackPen.EndCap = LineCap.DiamondAnchor;
				break;
			case 3:
				blackPen.EndCap = LineCap.Flat;
				break;
			case 4:
				blackPen.EndCap = LineCap.Round;
				break;
			case 5:
				blackPen.EndCap = LineCap.RoundAnchor;
				break;
			case 6:
				blackPen.EndCap = LineCap.Square;
				break;
			case 7:
				blackPen.EndCap = LineCap.SquareAnchor;
				break;
			case 8:
				blackPen.EndCap = LineCap.Triangle;
				break;
			}
			g.DrawLine(blackPen, rect.X + 30, rect.Y + rect.Height / 2, rect.X + rect.Width - 30, rect.Y + rect.Height / 2);
		}

		private void done()
		{
			Ok();
		}

		protected override void DrawRectHilight(Graphics g, Rectangle rect, int n)
		{
			drawLine(g, rect, n);
		}

		protected override void DrawRectUnHilight(Graphics g, Rectangle rect, int n)
		{
			drawLine(g, rect, n);
		}

		private void InitializeComponent()
		{
			base.Name = "LineCapStyleCtrl";
			base.Size = new System.Drawing.Size(88, 200);
		}

		protected override void DrawRectClick(Graphics g, Rectangle rect, int n)
		{
			drawLine(g, rect, n);
			ltype = (LineCapStyle)clickId;
			clickId = -1;
			done();
		}

		public override void SetValue(object val)
		{
			ltype = (LineCapStyle)val;
		}

		public override object GetValue()
		{
			return ltype;
		}
	}
