		private void addPaintElementButton_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			PaintElement paintElement = new PaintElement();
			base.Collection.Add(paintElement);
			listBox.SelectedIndex = listBox.Items.Add(paintElement);
			RefreshChart();
		}

		private void propertyValueChanged(object s, PropertyValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			previewPictureBox.Invalidate();
			propertyGrid.Invalidate();
		}

		private void showPreview_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			previewGroupBox.Visible = showPreview.Checked;
		}

		private void previewPictureBox_Paint(object sender, PaintEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(propertyGrid.SelectedObject is PaintElement ele))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				Brush brush = PaintElement.GetBrush(ele, e.ClipRectangle);
				if (brush != Brushes.Transparent)
				{
					e.Graphics.FillRectangle(brush, e.ClipRectangle);
				}
				else
				{
					e.Graphics.Clear(Color.Transparent);
				}
			}
			catch (InvalidOperationException)
			{
				e.Graphics.Clear(Color.Transparent);
			}
		}

		private void propertyGrid_PropertyValueChanged(object s, PropertyValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			previewPictureBox.Invalidate();
			propertyGrid.Invalidate();
		}

		private void propertyGrid_SelectedObjectsChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			previewPictureBox.Invalidate();
			propertyGrid.Invalidate();
		}
	}

		protected override void OnCancel()
		{
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = OldCollection as SeriesCollection;
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection2 = base.Collection as SeriesCollection;
			if (base.Collection.ChartComponent != null && base.Collection.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Composite) is CompositeChartAppearance compositeChartAppearance)
			{
				foreach (ChartLayerAppearance item in (IEnumerable)compositeChartAppearance.ChartLayers)
				{
					foreach (ISeries item2 in seriesCollection2)
					{
						if (item.Series.Contains(item2) && seriesCollection.FromKey(item2.Key) != null)
						{
							int num = item.Series.IndexOf(item2);
							if (num > -1 && num < item.Series.Count)
							{
								item.Series[num] = seriesCollection.FromKey(item2.Key);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnCancel();
		}

		protected override void RefreshChart()
		{
			if (base.Collection != null && base.Collection.ChartComponent != null && base.Collection.ChartComponent is Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart)
			{
				((DataAppearance)base.Collection.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data)).SetDirty(dirty: true);
			}
			base.RefreshChart();
		}
	}
	public class SeriesDataColumnEditor : UITypeEditor
	{
		public virtual Hashtable AcceptedTypes => null;

		public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return UITypeEditorEditStyle.DropDown;
		}

		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
		{
			if (context != null && context.Instance != null && provider != null)
			{
				IWindowsFormsEditorService windowsFormsEditorService = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
				if (windowsFormsEditorService != null)
				{
					StringCollection stringCollection = new StringCollection();
					SeriesDataAppearance seriesDataAppearance = (SeriesDataAppearance)context.Instance;
					if (seriesDataAppearance.DataSource is DataTable || seriesDataAppearance.DataSource is DataSet)
					{
						DataTable dataTable;
						if (seriesDataAppearance.DataSource is DataSet)
						{
							DataSet dataSet = (DataSet)seriesDataAppearance.DataSource;
							if (dataSet.Tables.Count == 0)
							{
								return value;
							}
							dataTable = dataSet.Tables[0];
						}
						else
						{
							dataTable = (DataTable)seriesDataAppearance.DataSource;
						}
						foreach (DataColumn column in dataTable.Columns)
						{
							if (AcceptedTypes == null || AcceptedTypes[column.DataType] != null)
							{
								stringCollection.Add(column.ColumnName);
							}
						}
					}
					string[] array = new string[stringCollection.Count];
					stringCollection.CopyTo(array, 0);
					object defaultItem = null;
					if (array.Length > 0)
					{
						defaultItem = array[0];
					}
					DropDownListBox dropDownListBox = new DropDownListBox(array, defaultItem);
					if (dropDownListBox.PreferredHeight < dropDownListBox.Height)
					{
						dropDownListBox.Height = dropDownListBox.PreferredHeight;
					}
					windowsFormsEditorService.DropDownControl(dropDownListBox);
					if (dropDownListBox.SelectedItem != null && dropDownListBox.WasItemClicked)
					{
						value = dropDownListBox.SelectedItem;
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

	public class SeriesPickerEditor : UITypeEditor
	{
		private Form _designForm;

		[ComVisible(false)]
		[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
		{
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = value as SeriesCollection;
			if (context != null && context.Instance != null && provider != null && seriesCollection != null)
			{
				PropertyInfo property = context.Instance.GetType().GetProperty("Series");
				if (property != null && property.GetValue(context.Instance, null) is IChartCollection chartCollection)
				{
					SeriesCollection series = chartCollection.ChartComponent.Series;
					_designForm = new Form();
					ListBox listBox = new ListBox();
					listBox.SelectionMode = SelectionMode.MultiExtended;
					UltraLabel ultraLabel = new UltraLabel();
					((Control)(object)ultraLabel).Text = SR.GetString("SR_20052_1");
					((Control)(object)ultraLabel).Dock = DockStyle.Bottom;
					((Control)(object)ultraLabel).Height = 25;
					UltraButton ultraButton = new UltraButton();
					((Control)(object)ultraButton).Text = SR.GetString("SR_OK");
					_designForm.AcceptButton = ultraButton;
					((Control)(object)ultraButton).Dock = DockStyle.Bottom;
					_designForm.Text = SR.GetString("SR_20052_2");
					_designForm.Show();
					_designForm.Opacity = 0.0;
					_designForm.Controls.Add((Control)(object)ultraLabel);
					_designForm.Controls.Add((Control)(object)ultraButton);
					_designForm.Controls.Add(listBox);
					listBox.Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
					((Control)(object)ultraButton).Click += OkButtonClick;
					listBox.Items.AddRange(series.ToArray());
					for (int i = 0; i < listBox.Items.Count; i++)
					{
						if (listBox.Items[i] is ISeries series2 && seriesCollection.FromKey(series2.Key) != null)
						{
							listBox.SetSelected(i, value: true);
						}
					}
					_designForm.Visible = false;
					_designForm.Opacity = 100.0;
					if (_designForm.ShowDialog() == DialogResult.OK)
					{
						seriesCollection.Clear();
						foreach (ISeries selectedItem in listBox.SelectedItems)
						{
							seriesCollection.Add(selectedItem);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void OkButtonClick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_designForm.DialogResult = DialogResult.OK;
			_designForm.Close();
		}

		[ComVisible(false)]
		[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
		public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)

			if (context != null && context.Instance != null)

				return UITypeEditorEditStyle.Modal;
			}
			return base.GetEditStyle(context);
		}

		[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
		public override bool GetPaintValueSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return false;
		}

		private void update()
		{
			if (base.Context != null)
			{
				base.Context.OnComponentChanged();
			}
			if (base.Editor != null)
			{
				base.Editor.edSvc.CloseDropDown();
				if (base.Component != null && base.Component is IChartComponent)
				{
					((IChartComponent)base.Component).Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
				}
			}
		}

		private void panel1_Paint(object sender, PaintEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Graphics.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
			Font fONT_DEFAULT = FONT_DEFAULT;
			Pen pen = new Pen(Color.Blue, 1f);
			Brush blue = Brushes.Blue;
			int num = 3;
			Point point = new Point(panel1.Width / 2, panel1.Height / 2);
			SizeF sizeF = e.Graphics.MeasureString(text, fONT_DEFAULT);
			if (base.Component is ITextOrientation textOrientation)
			{
				int num2 = (int)(sizeF.Width * (float)(new int[3] { 1, 0, -1 })[(int)textOrientation.HorizontalAlign] / 2f);
				int num3 = (int)(sizeF.Height * (float)(new int[3] { 1, 0, -1 })[(int)textOrientation.VerticalAlign] / 2f);
				int num4 = (int)(sizeF.Width * (float)(new int[3] { -1, -1, 1 })[(int)textOrientation.HorizontalAlign] / 2f);
				int num5 = (int)(sizeF.Height * (float)(new int[3] { 1, 0, -1 })[(int)textOrientation.VerticalAlign] / 2f);
				int num6 = (int)((float)(point.X + num2) - sizeF.Width / 2f);
				int num7 = (int)((float)(point.Y + num3) - sizeF.Height / 2f);
				int num8 = (int)((float)(num6 - num4) + sizeF.Width / 2f);
				int num9 = (int)((float)(num7 - num5) + sizeF.Height / 2f);
				Point point2 = new Point(num8, num9);
				Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
				matrix.Translate(-point.X, -point.Y);
				matrix.Rotate(-textOrientation.OrientationAngle, MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Translate(point.X, point.Y, MatrixOrder.Append);
				GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPath.AddRectangle(new Rectangle(num6, num7, (int)sizeF.Width, (int)sizeF.Height));
				Point point3 = new Point((int)((float)num6 + sizeF.Width / 2f), (int)((float)num7 + sizeF.Height / 2f));
				pts = new Point[3] { point3, point, point2 };
				matrix.TransformPoints(pts);
				e.Graphics.Transform = matrix.Clone();
				e.Graphics.ResetTransform();
				if (textOrientation.Flip)
				{
					Matrix matrix2 = new Matrix();
					int num10 = pts[0].X;
					int num11 = pts[0].Y;
					matrix2.Translate(-num10, -num11, MatrixOrder.Append);
					matrix2.Rotate(180f, MatrixOrder.Append);
					matrix2.Translate(num10, num11, MatrixOrder.Append);
					matrix.Multiply(matrix2, MatrixOrder.Append);
				}
				e.Graphics.Transform = matrix;
				e.Graphics.DrawPath(pen, graphicsPath);
				e.Graphics.DrawString(text, fONT_DEFAULT, blue, num6, num7);
				e.Graphics.ResetTransform();
				e.Graphics.DrawLine(pen, point.X, point.Y, pts[1].X, pts[1].Y);
				if (down)
				{
					e.Graphics.DrawLine(pen, pts[1].X, pts[1].Y, pts[1].X + 200, pts[1].Y);
					e.Graphics.DrawLine(pen, cur_x, cur_y, pts[1].X, pts[1].Y);
				}
				e.Graphics.FillEllipse(blue, point.X - num, point.Y - num, num * 2, num * 2);
				e.Graphics.FillEllipse(pickPath1_br, pts[1].X - num, pts[1].Y - num, num * 2, num * 2);
				e.Graphics.FillEllipse(pickPath2_br, pts[2].X - num, pts[2].Y - num, num * 2, num * 2);
				pickPath1.Dispose();
				pickPath1 = new GraphicsPath();
				pickPath1.AddEllipse(pts[1].X - num, pts[1].Y - num, num * 2, num * 2);
				pickPath2.Dispose();
				pickPath2 = new GraphicsPath();
				pickPath2.AddEllipse(pts[2].X - num, pts[2].Y - num, num * 2, num * 2);
			}
		}

		private void panel1_MouseDown(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			down = true;
			down_x = e.X;
			down_y = e.Y;
		}

		private void panel1_MouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			cur_x = e.X;
			cur_y = e.Y;
			if (pickPath2.IsVisible(e.X, e.Y))
			{
				if (!pickPath2_hi)
				{
					pickPath2_hi = true;
					pickPath2_br = Brushes.Red;
					panel1.Invalidate();
				}
			}
			else if (pickPath2_hi && !down)
			{
				pickPath2_hi = false;
				pickPath2_br = Brushes.Blue;
				panel1.Invalidate();
			}
			if (!down || pts == null || !pickPath2_hi)
			{
				return;
			}
			Math.Atan2(pts[1].X - pts[2].X, pts[1].Y - pts[2].Y);
			double num = Math.Atan2(pts[1].X - cur_x, pts[1].Y - cur_y);
			ITextOrientation textOrientation = base.Component as ITextOrientation;
			if (textOrientation != null)
			{
				if (textOrientation.HorizontalAlign == StringAlignment.Far)
				{
					textOrientation.OrientationAngle = (int)(180.0 * num / Math.PI + 90.0 - 180.0);
				}
				else
				{
					textOrientation.OrientationAngle = (int)(180.0 * num / Math.PI + 90.0);
				}
			}
			angle = textOrientation.OrientationAngle;
			panel1.Invalidate();
		}

		private void panel1_MouseUp(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			down = false;
			if (pickPath1_hi)
			{
				pickPath1_hi = false;
				pickPath1_br = Brushes.Red;
				panel1.Invalidate();
			}
		}

		private void button1_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Context != null)
			{
				base.Context.OnComponentChanged();
			}
			if (base.Editor != null)
			{
				base.Editor.edSvc.CloseDropDown();
				UpdateSkin();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSkin()
		{
			if (base.Component is ITextOrientation textOrientation)
			{
				SetValue(angle);
				textOrientation.OrientationAngle = angle;
			}
		}

		private void checkBox1_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Component is ITextOrientation textOrientation)
			{
				textOrientation.Flip = checkBoxFlip.Checked;
				panel1.Invalidate();
			}
		}

		public override void SetValue(object val)
		{
			base.SetValue(val);
			if (base.Component is ITextOrientation textOrientation)
			{
				old_Value_Angle = (angle = textOrientation.OrientationAngle);
				bool flag = (checkBoxFlip.Checked = textOrientation.Flip);
				old_Value_Flip = flag;
				old_Value_HorizontalAlign = textOrientation.HorizontalAlign;
				old_Value_VerticalAlign = textOrientation.VerticalAlign;
			}
		}

		private void buttonCancel_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Component is ITextOrientation textOrientation)
			{
				textOrientation.OrientationAngle = (angle = old_Value_Angle);
				bool flip = (checkBoxFlip.Checked = old_Value_Flip);
				textOrientation.Flip = flip;
				textOrientation.HorizontalAlign = old_Value_HorizontalAlign;
				textOrientation.VerticalAlign = old_Value_VerticalAlign;
			}
			if (base.Context != null)
			{
				base.Context.OnComponentChanged();
			}
			if (base.Editor != null)
			{
				base.Editor.edSvc.CloseDropDown();
			}
		}

		private void ShadowEditorCtrl_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)checkBoxFlip).Text = SR.GetString("SR_FLIP");
			text = SR.GetString("SR_LABEL");
			((Control)(object)buttonCancel).Text = SR.GetString("SR_Cancel");
			((Control)(object)buttonOK).Text = SR.GetString("SR_OK");
			stringAlignmentEditor = new StringAlignmentEditorControl();
			stringAlignmentEditor.Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
			stringAlignmentEditor.SetValue(base.Component as ITextAlignment);
			stringAlignmentEditor.ValueChanged += stringAlignmentEditor_ValueChanged;
			panel2.Controls.Add(stringAlignmentEditor);
			editAlignment.Checked = false;
		}

		private void stringAlignmentEditor_ValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Component is ITextAlignment textAlignment)
			{
				textAlignment.HorizontalAlign = stringAlignmentEditor.HorizontalAlign;
				textAlignment.VerticalAlign = stringAlignmentEditor.VerticalAlign;
				panel1.Invalidate();
			}
		}

		private void editAlignment_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			panel2.Visible = editAlignment.Checked;
			panel1.Invalidate();
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{
				if (topLeft.Checked || middleLeft.Checked || bottomLeft.Checked)
				{
					return StringAlignment.Near;
				}
				if (topMiddle.Checked || middleMiddle.Checked || bottomMiddle.Checked)
				{
					return StringAlignment.Center;
				}
				return StringAlignment.Far;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (topLeft.Checked || topMiddle.Checked || topRight.Checked)
				{
					return StringAlignment.Near;

				if (middleLeft.Checked || middleMiddle.Checked || middleRight.Checked)
				{
					return StringAlignment.Center;
				}
				return StringAlignment.Far;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		private void editors_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(sender is UltraCheckEditor { Checked: not false } ultraCheckEditor))
			{
				return;
			}
			_SuspendValidation = true;
			foreach (Control control in base.Controls)
			{
				if (control is UltraCheckEditor { Checked: not false } ultraCheckEditor2 && ultraCheckEditor2 != sender)
				{
					ultraCheckEditor2.Checked = false;
					((UltraControlBase)ultraCheckEditor2).SupportThemes = true;
					((UltraControlBase)ultraCheckEditor).DrawFilter = null;
				}
			}
			_SuspendValidation = false;
			if (this.ValueChanged != null)
			{
				this.ValueChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			((Control)(object)hAlignLabel).Text = SR.GetString("SR_HorizontalAlign") + ((ITextAlignment)this).HorizontalAlign;
			((Control)(object)vAlignLabel).Text = SR.GetString("SR_VerticalAlign") + ((ITextAlignment)this).VerticalAlign;
			((UltraControlBase)ultraCheckEditor).SupportThemes = false;
			((UltraControlBase)ultraCheckEditor).DrawFilter = (IUIElementDrawFilter)(object)_StateButtonDrawFilter;
		}

		private void editors_ValidateCheckState(object sender, ValidateCheckStateEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!_SuspendValidation)
			{
				e.NewCheckState = CheckState.Checked;
			}
		}

		public virtual void SetValue(ITextAlignment textAlign)
		{
			if (textAlign == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (textAlign.HorizontalAlign)
			{
			case StringAlignment.Near:
				switch (textAlign.VerticalAlign)
				{
				case StringAlignment.Near:
					topLeft.Checked = true;
					break;
				case StringAlignment.Center:
					middleLeft.Checked = true;
					break;
				case StringAlignment.Far:
					bottomLeft.Checked = true;
					break;
				}
				break;
			case StringAlignment.Center:
				switch (textAlign.VerticalAlign)
				{
				case StringAlignment.Near:
					topMiddle.Checked = true;
					break;
				case StringAlignment.Center:
					middleMiddle.Checked = true;
					break;
				case StringAlignment.Far:
					bottomMiddle.Checked = true;
					break;
				}
				break;
			case StringAlignment.Far:
				switch (textAlign.VerticalAlign)
				{
				case StringAlignment.Near:
					topRight.Checked = true;
					break;
				case StringAlignment.Center:
					middleRight.Checked = true;
					break;
				case StringAlignment.Far:
					bottomRight.Checked = true;
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void StringAlignmentEditorControl_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
		}
	}

		private void numericUpDown1_ValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			trackBar1.Value = (int)numericUpDown1.Value;
			pictureBox1.Invalidate();
			ytheta = trackBar1.Value;
			autoUpdate();
		}

		private void numericUpDown4_ValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			trackBar4.Value = (int)numericUpDown4.Value;
			autoUpdate();
		}

		private void trackBar4_Scroll(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			numericUpDown4.Value = trackBar4.Value;
			pictureBox1.Invalidate();
			autoUpdate();
		}

		private void autoUpdate()
		{
			UpdateLocal();
			((IChartComponent)base.Component).Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
		}

		private void button1_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			vApp.Perspective = (float)numericUpDown4.Value;
			vApp.Scale = (float)numericUpDown3.Value;
			vApp.XRotation = (float)numericUpDown2.Value;
			vApp.YRotation = (float)numericUpDown1.Value;
			UpdateLocal();
			Apply();
			Ok();
		}

		private void button2_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			NumericUpDown numericUpDown = this.numericUpDown4;
			int num = (trackBar4.Value = 50);
			numericUpDown.Value = num;
			NumericUpDown numericUpDown2 = this.numericUpDown3;
			int num3 = (trackBar3.Value = 65);
			numericUpDown2.Value = num3;
			NumericUpDown numericUpDown3 = this.numericUpDown2;
			int num5 = (trackBar2.Value = 144);
			numericUpDown3.Value = num5;
			NumericUpDown numericUpDown4 = numericUpDown1;
			int num7 = (trackBar1.Value = 12);
			numericUpDown4.Value = num7;
			UpdateLocal();
			Apply();
			pictureBox1.Invalidate();
			((IChartComponent)base.Component).Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
		}

		private void button3_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Cancel();
		}

		private void UpdateLocal()
		{
			vApp.Perspective = trackBar4.Value;
			vApp.Scale = trackBar3.Value;
			vApp.XRotation = trackBar2.Value;
			vApp.YRotation = trackBar1.Value;
		}

		private void UpdateFromLocal()
		{
			trackBar4.Value = (int)vApp.Perspective;
			trackBar3.Value = (int)vApp.Scale;
			trackBar2.Value = (int)vApp.XRotation % 180;
			trackBar1.Value = (int)vApp.YRotation % 180;
			numericUpDown4.Value = (int)vApp.Perspective;
			numericUpDown3.Value = (int)vApp.Scale;
			numericUpDown2.Value = (int)vApp.XRotation % 180;
			numericUpDown1.Value = (int)vApp.YRotation % 180;
			xtheta = trackBar2.Value;
			ytheta = trackBar1.Value;
		}

		private void checkBox1_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)button2).Enabled = !checkBox1.Checked;
		}

		private void apictureBox1_MouseDown(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			prevx = e.X;
			prevy = e.Y;
		}

		private void pictureBox1_MouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				xtheta += (float)(prevy - e.Y) * 360f / (float)base.Width;
				ytheta += (float)(prevx - e.X) * 360f / (float)base.Height;
				if (xtheta > 180f)
				{
					xtheta -= 360f;
				}
				if (ytheta > 180f)
				{
					ytheta -= 360f;
				}
				if (xtheta < -180f)
				{
					xtheta += 360f;
				}
				if (ytheta < -180f)
				{
					ytheta += 360f;
				}
				vApp.XRotation = xtheta;
				vApp.YRotation = ytheta;
				UpdateFromLocal();
				pictureBox1.Invalidate();
				if (checkBox1.Checked)
				{
					((IChartComponent)base.Component).Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
				}
			}
			prevx = e.X;
			prevy = e.Y;
		}

		private void pictureBox1_MouseWheel(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Delta > 0)
			{
				scale += 5f;
			}
			if (e.Delta < 0)
			{
				scale -= 5f;
			}
			vApp.Scale = scale;
			UpdateFromLocal();
			if (checkBox1.Checked)
			{
				((IChartComponent)base.Component).Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
		}

		public override void SetValue(object val)
		{
			vApp = (View3DAppearance)val;
			UpdateFromLocal();
		}

		public override object GetValue()
		{
			return vApp;
		}

		private void pictureBox1_Paint(object sender, PaintEventArgs e)
		{
			View3DAppearance.DrawSampleScene(vApp, e.Graphics);
		}
	}

			: base(typeof(View3DCtrl))
		{
		}
	}

	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	public class PEPanel : Panel
	{
		private Container components;

		private Box b1;

		private IFGGraphics2D render = new IFGGraphics2D();

		private PaintElement _PE = new PaintElement();

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[Editor(typeof(ArrayEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public PaintElement PE
		{
			get
			{
				return _PE;
			}
			set
			{
				_PE = value;
			}
		}

		public PEPanel()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			b1 = new Box(base.Bounds);
			b1.PE = _PE;
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)
		{
			render.G = e.Graphics;
			b1.rect = new Rectangle(0, 0, base.Width, base.Height);
			b1.PE = _PE;
			render.Draw(b1);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && components != null)
			{
				components.Dispose();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		private void InitializeComponent()
		{
			this.components = new System.ComponentModel.Container();
		}
	}
	public interface IPropPack
	{
		object DataSource { get; set; }

		string DataMember { get; set; }
	}
	public class WinPropPack : IPropPack
	{
		internal class DataMemberUITypeEditor : UITypeEditor
		{
			public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return UITypeEditorEditStyle.DropDown;
			}

			public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
			{
				if (context != null && context.Instance is WinPropPack)
				{
					WinPropPack winPropPack = context.Instance as WinPropPack;
					CustomTypeDesciptorContext context2 = new CustomTypeDesciptorContext(context);
					UITypeEditor uITypeEditor = null;
					PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(winPropPack._Component)["DataMember"];
					if (propertyDescriptor != null)
					{
						uITypeEditor = propertyDescriptor.GetEditor(typeof(UITypeEditor)) as UITypeEditor;
					}
					if (uITypeEditor == null)
					{
						Type type = Type.GetType("System.Windows.Forms.Design.DataMemberListEditor, System.Design");
						if (type != null)
						{
							uITypeEditor = Activator.CreateInstance(type, type.IsNotPublic) as UITypeEditor;
						}
					}
					if (uITypeEditor != null)
					{
						return uITypeEditor.EditValue(context2, provider, value);
					}
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

		private object _DataSource;

		private string _DataMember;

		private IComponent _Component;

	internal class CustomTypeDesciptorContext : ITypeDescriptorContext, IServiceProvider
	{
		private ITypeDescriptorContext baseContext;

		IContainer ITypeDescriptorContext.Container
		{
			get
			{
				if (baseContext != null && baseContext.Instance != null)
				{
					if (baseContext.Instance is WebPropPack)
					{
						return ((WebPropPack)baseContext.Instance).Component.Site.Container;
					}
					if (baseContext.Instance is WinPropPack)
					{
						return ((WinPropPack)baseContext.Instance).Component.Site.Container;
					}
				}
				return baseContext.Container;
			}
		}

		object ITypeDescriptorContext.Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (baseContext != null && baseContext.Instance != null && baseContext.Instance is WebPropPack)
				{
					return ((WebPropPack)baseContext.Instance).Component;
				}
				return baseContext.Instance;
			}
		}

		PropertyDescriptor ITypeDescriptorContext.PropertyDescriptor => baseContext.PropertyDescriptor;

		public CustomTypeDesciptorContext(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			baseContext = context;
		}

		object IServiceProvider.GetService(Type serviceType)
		{
			return baseContext.GetService(serviceType);
		}

		bool ITypeDescriptorContext.OnComponentChanging()
		{
			return baseContext.OnComponentChanging();
		}

		void ITypeDescriptorContext.OnComponentChanged()
		{
			baseContext.OnComponentChanged();
		}
	}

		public SceneGraphControl()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			M_Render = new ChartRender(this);
			M_Box = new Box(base.Bounds);
			M_DesignTimeScene = new SceneGraph();
			M_DesignTimeScene.Add(M_Box);
			PaintElement pE = new PaintElement
			{
				Fill = Color.Red,
				Stroke = Color.LightGray,
				FillOpacity = byte.MaxValue,
				StrokeOpacity = byte.MaxValue,
				FillStopOpacity = byte.MaxValue,
				ElementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill,
				Hatch = FillHatchStyle.Percent10
			};
			M_Disabled = new SceneGraph();
			disableBox = new Box(base.Bounds);
			disableBox.PE = pE;
			M_Disabled.Add(disableBox);
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializePE()
		{
			return _PE.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		public void ResetPE()
		{
			_PE.ResetAll();
		}

		protected override void OnSizeChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnSizeChanged(e);
			Invalidate();
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs pe)
		{
			base.OnPaint(pe);
			M_Box.rect = new Rectangle(0, 0, base.Width - 1, base.Height - 1);
			M_Box.PE = _PE;
			if (Site != null && Site.DesignMode)
			{
				M_Render.RenderSceneGraph(M_DesignTimeScene, pe.Graphics);
			}
			else
			{
				M_Render.RenderSceneGraph(M_Scene, pe.Graphics);
			}
			if (!base.Enabled)
			{
				disableBox.rect = base.Bounds;
				M_Render.RenderSceneGraph(M_Disabled, pe.Graphics);
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && components != null)
			{
				components.Dispose();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		private void InitializeComponent()
		{
			base.Name = "SceneGraphControl";
			base.Size = new System.Drawing.Size(120, 24);
		}
	}
	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	public class RoundRectGroupBox : SceneGraphControl
	{
		private IContainer components;

		private int _Roundness = 5;

		private Text _Text;

		private string _TitleText = "Round Group Box";

		public int Roundness
		{
			get
			{
				return _Roundness;
			}
			set
			{
				_Roundness = value;
				Invalidate();
			}
		}

		public string TitleText
		{
			get
			{
				return _TitleText;
			}
			set
			{
				_TitleText = value;
				Invalidate();
			}
		}

		public RoundRectGroupBox()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			_Text = new Text();
			_Text.SetTextString(_TitleText);
			base.Scene.Add(_Text);
			base.Scene.Add(M_Box);
			GraphicsContext graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
			graphicsContext.ResetClip();
			M_Scene.Add(graphicsContext);
			M_DesignTimeScene.Add(_Text);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && components != null)
			{
				components.Dispose();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs pe)
		{
			_Text.SetTextString(_TitleText);
			_Text.labelStyle.Font = Font;
			_Text.labelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
			SizeF sizeF = pe.Graphics.MeasureString(_TitleText, Font);
			M_Box.Roundness = _Roundness;
			M_Box.rect = new Rectangle(0, (int)sizeF.Height, base.Width - 1, (int)((float)base.Height - sizeF.Height - 1f));
			M_Box.PE = base.PE;
			if (Site != null && Site.DesignMode)
			{
				M_Render.RenderSceneGraph(M_DesignTimeScene, pe.Graphics);
			}
			else
			{
				M_Render.RenderSceneGraph(M_Scene, pe.Graphics);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeComponent()
		{
			base.Name = "RoundRectGroupBox";
			base.Size = new System.Drawing.Size(136, 32);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class SR
	{
		private static SR loader;

		private ResourceManager resources;

		private SR()
		{
			string baseName = "Infragistics.UltraChart.Design.Strings";
			resources = new ResourceManager(baseName, GetType().Assembly);
		}

		private static SR GetLoader()
		{
			if (loader == null)
			{
				lock (typeof(SR))
				{
					if (loader == null)
					{
						loader = new SR();
					}
				}
			}
			return loader;
		}

		public static string GetString(string name)
		{
			return GetString(null, name);
		}

		public static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetString(null, name, args);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetString(culture, name, null);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			SR sR = GetLoader();
			if (sR == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = sR.resources.GetString(name, culture);
			if (args != null && args.Length > 0)
			{
				text = string.Format(text, args);
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static Bitmap GetBitmap(string name)
		{
			SR sR = GetLoader();
			if (sR == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (Bitmap)sR.resources.GetObject(name);
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
	internal sealed class LocalizedCategoryAttribute : CategoryAttribute
	{
		public LocalizedCategoryAttribute(string category)
			: base(category)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetLocalizedString(string value)
		{
			return SR.GetString(value);
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
	internal sealed class LocalizedDescriptionAttribute : DescriptionAttribute
	{
		private bool loaded;

		public override string Description
		{
			get
			{
				if (!loaded)
				{
					loaded = true;
					base.DescriptionValue = SR.GetString(base.Description);
				}
				return base.Description;
			}
		}

		public LocalizedDescriptionAttribute(string description)
			: base(description)
		{
		}
	}

					roundRectTextBox1.TextBox.Text = _SelectedObject.Text;

				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFont()
		{
			Font font = _SelectedObject.Font;
			try
			{
				_SelectedObject.Font = new Font(font, _FontStyle);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException ex)
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(this, string.Format(SR.GetString("SR_FontNotSupported"), ex.Message));
			}
		}

		private void textBox1_TextChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_SelectedObject.Text = roundRectTextBox1.TextBox.Text;
		}

		private void button4_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_SelectedObject.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
		}

		private void button5_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_SelectedObject.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
		}

		private void button6_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_SelectedObject.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Far;
		}

		private void button1_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_FontStyle ^= FontStyle.Bold;
			UpdateFont();
		}

		private void button2_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_FontStyle ^= FontStyle.Italic;
			UpdateFont();
		}

		private void button3_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_FontStyle ^= FontStyle.Underline;
			UpdateFont();
		}

		private void button7_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			fontDialog1.Font = _SelectedObject.Font;
			if (fontDialog1.ShowDialog() != DialogResult.Cancel)
			{
				_SelectedObject.Font = fontDialog1.Font;
			}
		}

		private void fontDialog1_Apply(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_SelectedObject.Font = fontDialog1.Font;
		}

		private void checkBox1_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_SelectedObject.Visible = checkBox1.Checked;
		}

		private void button8_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_SelectedObject.ResetExtent();
			_SelectedObject.Font = _FontCached;
			_SelectedObject.ResetFontColor();
			_SelectedObject.ResetHorizontalAlign();
			_SelectedObject.ResetText();
			_SelectedObject.ResetWrapText();
			roundRectTextBox1.TextBox.Text = _SelectedObject.Text;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Editor
{
	public class UltraChartDesignerActionList : DesignerActionList
	{
		private class AssemblyRef
		{
			private const string DllPrefix = "Infragistics2";

			public const string CommonDesignDll = "Infragistics2.WebUI.Design.v15.1, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb";

			private const string AssemblyVersionString = "Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb";
		}

		private Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart _ChartComponent;

		private UltraWinChartDesigner _Designer;

		private DesignerActionService _DesignerActionService;

		private DesignerActionUIService _DesignerActionUIService;

		private string _LoadPreset = SR.GetString("SR_20053CLR2_23");

		private Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart ChartComponent
		{
			get
			{
				return _ChartComponent;
			}
			set
			{
				_ChartComponent = value;
			}
		}

		private UltraWinChartDesigner Designer
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Designer == null && GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) is IDesignerHost designerHost)
				{
					_Designer = designerHost.GetDesigner(base.Component) as UltraWinChartDesigner;
				}
				return _Designer;
			}
		}

		private DesignerActionService DesignerActionService
		{
			get
			{
				return _DesignerActionService;
			}
			set
			{
				_DesignerActionService = value;
			}
		}

		private DesignerActionUIService DesignerActionUIService
		{
			get
			{
				return _DesignerActionUIService;
			}
			set
			{
				_DesignerActionUIService = value;
			}
		}

		[Editor(typeof(ChartTypeEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		public ChartType ChartType
		{
			get
			{
				return ChartComponent.ChartType;
			}
			set
			{
				TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(ChartComponent)["ChartType"].SetValue(ChartComponent, value);
				DesignerActionUIService.Refresh(base.Component);
			}
		}

		[Editor(typeof(GridEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		public ChartGridAppearance Axis
		{
			get
			{
				return _ChartComponent.Axis;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = new ChartGridAppearance(ChartComponent);
				}
				TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(base.Component)["Axis"].SetValue(base.Component, value);
				RefreshChart();
			}
		}

		[Editor("Infragistics.WebUI.Design.PresetPickerEditor, Infragistics2.WebUI.Design.v15.1, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		public object LoadPreset
		{
			get
			{
				return _LoadPreset;
			}
			set
			{
				_LoadPreset = value as string;
				RefreshChart();
			}
		}

		public UltraChartDesignerActionList(IComponent component)
			: base(component)
		{
			ChartComponent = component as Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart;
			DesignerActionService = GetService(typeof(DesignerActionService)) as DesignerActionService;
			DesignerActionUIService = GetService(typeof(DesignerActionUIService)) as DesignerActionUIService;
		}

		public override DesignerActionItemCollection GetSortedActionItems()
		{
			DesignerActionItemCollection designerActionItemCollection = new DesignerActionItemCollection();
			string text = SR.GetString("SR_20053CLR2_01");
			string text2 = SR.GetString("SR_20053CLR2_10");
			string text3 = SR.GetString("SR_20053CLR2_12");
			designerActionItemCollection.Add(new DesignerActionHeaderItem(text));
			designerActionItemCollection.Add(new DesignerActionMethodItem(this, "ShowChartWizard", SR.GetString("SR_20053CLR2_02"), text, SR.GetString("SR_20053CLR2_03"), includeAsDesignerVerb: false));
			designerActionItemCollection.Add(new DesignerActionMethodItem(this, "LoadPresets", SR.GetString("SR_20063CLR2_01"), text, SR.GetString("SR_20063CLR2_01"), includeAsDesignerVerb: false));
			designerActionItemCollection.Add(new DesignerActionHeaderItem(text2));
			designerActionItemCollection.Add(new DesignerActionPropertyItem("ChartType", SR.GetString("SR_20053CLR2_08"), text2, SR.GetString("SR_20053CLR2_09")));
			if (ChartComponent == null || ChartComponent.ChartType != ChartType.Composite)
			{
				designerActionItemCollection.Add(new DesignerActionHeaderItem(text3));
				designerActionItemCollection.Add(new DesignerActionPropertyItem("Axis", SR.GetString("SR_20053CLR2_13"), text3, SR.GetString("SR_20053CLR2_14")));
			}
			return designerActionItemCollection;
		}

		public void ShowChartWizard()
		{
			if (Designer != null)
			{
				Designer.ShowChartWizard(outOfBox: false);
			}
			if (DesignerActionUIService != null)
			{
				DesignerActionUIService.HideUI(base.Component);
			}
		}

		public void LoadPresets()
		{
			if (Designer != null)
			{
				Designer.LoadPresets();
			}
			if (DesignerActionUIService != null)
			{
				DesignerActionUIService.HideUI(base.Component);
			}
		}

		public virtual void RefreshChart()
		{
			if (ChartComponent == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ChartComponent.InvalidateLayers();
			TypeDescriptor.Refresh(base.Component);
			if (ChartComponent.Site == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IComponentChangeService componentChangeService = (IComponentChangeService)ChartComponent.Site.GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService));
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(base.Component);
			if (properties != null)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = properties.Find("Visible", ignoreCase: false);
				if (propertyDescriptor != null && componentChangeService != null)
				{
					bool flag = (bool)propertyDescriptor.GetValue(base.Component);
					componentChangeService.OnComponentChanged(base.Component, propertyDescriptor, flag, flag);
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.WinChartHelper
{
	public class UltraChartCodeDomSerializer : CodeDomSerializer
	{
		public override object Serialize(IDesignerSerializationManager manager, object value)
		{
			if (manager == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("manager");
			}
			Type baseType = typeof(UltraChart).BaseType;
			CodeDomSerializer codeDomSerializer = manager.GetSerializer(baseType, typeof(CodeDomSerializer)) as CodeDomSerializer;
			object obj = codeDomSerializer.Serialize(manager, value);
			if (obj is CodeStatementCollection codeStatementCollection)
			{
				CodeStatement codeStatement = null;
				foreach (CodeStatement item in codeStatementCollection)
				{
					if (item is CodeAssignStatement { Left: CodePropertyReferenceExpression { PropertyName: "ChartType" } })
					{
						codeStatement = item;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (codeStatement != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < codeStatementCollection.Count; i++)
					{
						if (!(codeStatementCollection[i] is CodeCommentStatement) && (!(codeStatementCollection[i] is CodeAssignStatement codeAssignStatement2) || !(codeAssignStatement2.Left is CodeFieldReferenceExpression)))
						{
							codeStatementCollection.Remove(codeStatement);
							codeStatementCollection.Insert(i, codeStatement);
							codeStatementCollection.Insert(i, new CodeCommentStatement(string.Format(SR.GetString("SR_SERCODECOMMENT"), "ChartType", value.GetType().Name)));
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public override object Deserialize(IDesignerSerializationManager manager, object codeObject)
		{
			if (manager == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("manager");
			}
			Type baseType = typeof(UltraChart).BaseType;
			CodeDomSerializer codeDomSerializer = manager.GetSerializer(baseType, typeof(CodeDomSerializer)) as CodeDomSerializer;
			return codeDomSerializer.Deserialize(manager, codeObject);
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Design
{
	public class UltraWinChartDesigner : System.Windows.Forms.Design.ControlDesigner
	{
		private DesignerActionListCollection _ActionLists;

		public override DesignerVerbCollection Verbs
		{
			get
			{
				DesignerVerbCollection designerVerbCollection = new DesignerVerbCollection();
				designerVerbCollection.AddRange(base.Verbs);
				designerVerbCollection.Add(new DesignerVerb(SR.GetString("UltraComponentDesignerVerbAbout"), ShowAboutBox));
				designerVerbCollection.Add(new DesignerVerb(SR.GetString("Verb_ChartWizard"), VerbChartWiz));
				designerVerbCollection.Add(new DesignerVerb(SR.GetString("Verb_Presets"), VerbPresets));
				return designerVerbCollection;
			}
		}

		public override DesignerActionListCollection ActionLists
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ActionLists == null)
				{
					_ActionLists = new DesignerActionListCollection(new DesignerActionList[1]
					{
						new UltraChartDesignerActionList(base.Component)
					});
				}
				return _ActionLists;
			}
		}

		protected override void PostFilterProperties(IDictionary properties)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = (ArrayList)((IChartComponent)base.Component).GetComponentInfo();
			if (arrayList != null)
			{
				foreach (object item in arrayList)
				{
					if (properties.Contains(item.ToString()))
					{
						properties.Remove(item.ToString());
					}
				}
			}
			base.PostFilterProperties(properties);
		}

		internal void ShowChartWizard(bool outOfBox)
		{
			ChartWizard chartWizard = new ChartWizard();
			chartWizard.Component = base.Component;
			if (outOfBox)
			{
				chartWizard.ShowDialogOutOfBox(base.Component);
			}
			else
			{
				chartWizard.ShowDialog();
			}
			if (chartWizard != null)
			{
				chartWizard.Dispose();
				chartWizard = null;
			}
		}

		public void LoadPresets()
		{
			WinChartPresetsSelector winChartPresetsSelector = new WinChartPresetsSelector();
			if (winChartPresetsSelector != null)
			{
				winChartPresetsSelector.Component = base.Component;
				winChartPresetsSelector.ShowDialog(base.Component);
			}
			if (winChartPresetsSelector != null)
			{
				winChartPresetsSelector.Dispose();
				winChartPresetsSelector = null;
			}
		}

		private void VerbPresets(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			LoadPresets();
		}

	public class Util
	{
		public static void RefreshListBox(ListBox listBox)
		{
			object selectedItem = listBox.SelectedItem;
			object[] array = new object[listBox.Items.Count];
			listBox.Items.CopyTo(array, 0);
			listBox.Items.Clear();
			listBox.Items.AddRange(array);
			listBox.SelectedItem = selectedItem;
		}

		public static void PopulateItems(IList items, IList values)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			items.Clear();
			if (items is ValueListItemsCollection)
			{
				ValueListItemsCollection val = (ValueListItemsCollection)items;
				{
					foreach (object value in values)
					{
						val.Add(value);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			foreach (object value2 in values)
			{
				items.Add(value2);
			}
		}

		public static void AddEnumValues(Type enumType, ValueListItemsCollection items)
		{
			Enum.GetValues(enumType);
			FieldInfo[] fields = enumType.GetFields();
			FieldInfo[] array = fields;
			foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in array)
			{
				if (fieldInfo.FieldType == enumType && fieldInfo.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(CompositeChartBrowsableAttribute), inherit: false).Length == 0)
				{
					items.Add(fieldInfo.GetValue(enumType));
				}
			}
		}
	}

		protected override void OnLoad(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnLoad(e);
			Text = SR.GetString("SR_LoadPreset");

			((Control)(object)ultraLabel1).Text = SR.GetString("SR_BOTH");

		public void ShowDialog(IComponent component)
		{
			_Component = component;
			chart = (Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart)component;
			chart.SavePreset(origChart, "original", "", Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.WinChartHelper.PresetType.All);
			OriginalBackgroundImage = chart.BackgroundImage;
			Stream manifestResourceStream = GetType().Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("Infragistics.UltraChart.Design.DefaultPresets.UltraChartDefaultPreset.xml");
			ValueListItem val = ultraComboEditor1.Items.Add((object)manifestResourceStream, "Default");
			val.Appearance.Image = 2;
			((Control)(object)ultraComboEditor1).Text = SR.GetString("SR_PLEASESELECTAPRESET");
			((Control)(object)ultraLabel1).Text = SR.GetString("SR_BOTH");
			((Control)(object)ultraLabel2).Text = SR.GetString("SR_LOOK");
			((Control)(object)ultraLabel3).Text = SR.GetString("SR_BEHAVIOR");
			FileInfo[] array = null;
			if (WinPresetsFolder != null)
			{
				array = WinPresetsFolder.GetFiles();
				FileInfo[] array2 = array;
				foreach (FileInfo fileInfo in array2)
				{
					PresetInfoPair presetInfoFromFileInfo = GetPresetInfoFromFileInfo(fileInfo);
					if (presetInfoFromFileInfo != null)
					{
						string name = presetInfoFromFileInfo.Name;
						if (name.Length > 0)
						{
							ValueListItem val2 = ultraComboEditor1.Items.Add((object)fileInfo, name);
							val2.Appearance.Image = (int)presetInfoFromFileInfo.PresetType;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			ultraComboEditor1.Items.Add((object)"", SR.GetString("SR_PresetsSelector_Browse"));
			ultraComboEditor1.ValueChanged += Preset_Selected;
			ShowDialog();
		}

		private void Preset_Selected(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (ultraComboEditor1.SelectedItem.DataValue is FileInfo)
			{
				string fullName = ((FileInfo)ultraComboEditor1.SelectedItem.DataValue).FullName;
				chart.LoadPreset(fullName, reset: true);
			}
			else if (ultraComboEditor1.SelectedItem.DataValue is Stream)
			{
				Stream xtw = (Stream)ultraComboEditor1.SelectedItem.DataValue;
				chart.LoadPreset(xtw, reset: true);
			}
			else
			{
				if (WinPresetsFolder != null)
				{
					openFileDialog1.InitialDirectory = WinPresetsFolder.FullName;
				}
				DialogResult dialogResult = openFileDialog1.ShowDialog();
				if (dialogResult != DialogResult.Cancel)
				{
					FileInfo fileInfo = new FileInfo(openFileDialog1.FileName);
					PresetInfoPair presetInfoFromFileInfo = GetPresetInfoFromFileInfo(fileInfo);
					if (presetInfoFromFileInfo != null)
					{
						ValueListItem val = ultraComboEditor1.Items.Insert(((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)ultraComboEditor1.Items).Count - 1, (object)fileInfo, presetInfoFromFileInfo.Name);
						val.Appearance.Image = (int)presetInfoFromFileInfo.PresetType;
						ultraComboEditor1.SelectedItem = val;
						Preset_Selected(sender, e);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ultraComboEditor1.SelectedIndex = lastSelectedIndex;
				}
			}
			lastSelectedIndex = ultraComboEditor1.SelectedIndex;
		}

		private PresetInfoPair GetPresetInfoFromFileInfo(FileInfo fi)
		{
			try
			{
				FileStream xmlFragment = fi.OpenRead();
				NameTable nameTable = new NameTable();
				XmlNamespaceManager xmlNamespaceManager = new XmlNamespaceManager(nameTable);
				Type type = _Component.GetType();
				while (type != null && type != typeof(object))
				{
					Assembly assembly = type.Assembly;
					string[] array = null;
					if (assembly != null)
					{
						Attribute[] array2 = assembly.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(TagPrefixAttribute), inherit: true) as Attribute[];
						TagPrefixAttribute tagPrefixAttribute = null;
						if (array2 != null && array2.Length > 0)
						{
							array = new string[array2.Length];
							for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
							{
								tagPrefixAttribute = array2[i] as TagPrefixAttribute;
								array[i] = tagPrefixAttribute.TagPrefix;
							}
						}
					}
					if (array != null)
					{
						string[] array3 = array;
						foreach (string prefix in array3)
						{
							xmlNamespaceManager.AddNamespace(prefix, "");
						}
					}
					type = type.BaseType;
				}
				XmlParserContext context = new XmlParserContext(null, xmlNamespaceManager, null, XmlSpace.None);
				XmlTextReader reader = new XmlTextReader(xmlFragment, XmlNodeType.Element, context);
				XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
				xmlDocument.Load(reader);
				XmlNode xmlNode = xmlDocument.FirstChild;
				while (xmlNode != null && xmlNode.NodeType != XmlNodeType.Comment && xmlNode.NextSibling != null)
				{
					xmlNode = xmlNode.NextSibling;
				}
				if (xmlNode != null && xmlNode.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Comment)
				{
					PresetInfoPair presetInfoPair = new PresetInfoPair();
					XmlTextReader reader2 = new XmlTextReader(xmlNode.InnerText.Trim(), XmlNodeType.Element, null);
					XmlDocument xmlDocument2 = new XmlDocument();
					xmlDocument2.Load(reader2);
					XmlNode documentElement = xmlDocument2.DocumentElement;
					presetInfoPair.Name = documentElement.Attributes["PresetName"].Value;
					string text = documentElement.Attributes["PresetDescription"].Value.ToLower();
					if (text.IndexOf("behavior") != -1 && text.IndexOf("look") != -1)
					{
						presetInfoPair.PresetType = PresetType.Both;
					}
					else if (text.IndexOf("behavior") != -1)
					{
						presetInfoPair.PresetType = PresetType.Behavior;
					}
					else
					{
						presetInfoPair.PresetType = PresetType.Look;
					}
					return presetInfoPair;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void WinChartPresetsSelector_Closing(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (cancelPresetSelection)
			{
				StringReader xtw = new StringReader(origChart.GetStringBuilder().ToString());
				chart.LoadPreset(xtw, reset: true);
				chart.BackgroundImage = OriginalBackgroundImage;
			}
		}
